jobs.location: City of Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
jobs.description:
To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.

Job Title: Senior Project Manager

About the Company:

Our client is a growing marketing agency that serves as a key point of contact between clients and internal teams.

Job Description:

Our client is looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to join their team. This is a highly client-facing role for someone who can confidently manage client relationships, oversee multiple projects, coordinate cross-functional teams, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to a high standard. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, commercially minded, and comfortable taking ownership of projects from kickoff through completion.

Responsibilities of the role:

• Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned clients.
• Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships.
• Lead project kickoffs, establish timelines, define deliverables, and communicate expectations.
• Manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously across different clients.
• Coordinate designers, copywriters, developers, media buyers, strategists, and other internal team members.
• Track project progress, deadlines, budgets, and deliverables.
• Proactively identify risks, blockers, and potential delays and implement solutions.
• Communicate project updates, priorities, and next steps clearly with both clients and internal teams.
• Manage client feedback and ensure revisions are properly communicated and executed.
• Ensure projects remain aligned with client objectives, scope, and expectations.
• Conduct regular client meetings and presentations when needed.
• Help prioritize workloads and allocate resources across projects.
• Maintain accurate project documentation and status updates within the agency's project management tools.
• Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, workflows, and client experience.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• 4+ years of project management experience, preferably within a marketing, advertising, creative, or digital agency.
• Proven experience managing multiple clients and projects simultaneously.
• Strong client-facing and relationship-management skills.
• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
• Strong understanding of digital marketing and agency workflows.
• Experience coordinating cross-functional creative and marketing teams.
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
• Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
• Ability to work independently and take full ownership of projects.
• Comfortable managing changing priorities and working in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.

Preferred Skills:

• Previous experience working directly with U.S.-based clients.
• Experience managing marketing campaigns, creative production, paid media, SEO, social media, or web projects.
• Experience managing project budgets and scope.
• Agency experience with multiple concurrent accounts.
• Strong presentation and meeting facilitation skills.

Personality:

• Proactive rather than simply waiting for instructions.
• Brings structure, accountability, and professionalism to client relationships and internal operations.

Software & Tools:

• Experience with project management tools such as Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Trello, or similar platforms.

Schedule:

Full-Time 9-5 EST

Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.
• Full-time remote opportunity.

jobs.description:
TITLE:
Project Manager, Construction I

LOCATION:
Remote 3-1

Position Summmary

As Project Manager you will be responsible for providing leadership and driving success of multiple facets of data center projects. The position covers all aspects of construction. Areas of expertise require autonomy and independent discretion in the following areas:

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

RFP development and budgeting
Pre-bid oversight and coordination
Managing all design phases and documents
Conduct project meetings, publish, and distribute minutes, develop milestones, and maintain monthly reports.
Manage day-to-day office and field operations.
Review the plans and specifications for constructability and construction schedules. Advise the project team of any issues or deficiencies.
Prepare, manage, and update the detailed project schedule with sequence and activity duration including procurement items.
Customer engagement for sales and fulfillment of requirements
Coordination and supervision of design-build contractors
Coordination with internal stakeholders and subject matter experts
Oversight of physical construction activities
Participation in commissioning
The management of close out and hand-off of physical data center and project documents to customer
Collaborate with the design team, operators, and clients.
Submit monthly project financial reporting, including forecasting, cash-flow, etc.
Review monthly contractor billing and perform job walks to substantiate progress.
Keeps all relative parties informed of progress throughout the life of the project.
Develop, manage, maintain, and assist with contract negotiation of new and existing vendors.
Oversee RFI and Submittal Review Process.
Manage the Change Order Process with Owner and Subcontractors.
Manage input and delivery of work products from internal team members to ensure that new data center spaces comply with the project requirements, customer requirements, all engineering standards, applicable codes, and specifications.
Understand project budget/estimate and budget set-up.
Develop and understand trade contractor and supplier contract scopes, with a constant focus on procurement and lead-time of materials to maintain schedule.
Develop, document, and drive lessons learned, process improvements, cost, and schedule savings initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.
Work closely with the proposal team to coordinate design criteria with budgetary issues and ongoing maintenance and operation of existing facilities.
Awareness of the importance of mission-critical facility operation
Safety standards knowledge and enforcement. (OSHA 30 Hour preferred)

Schedule shifts may incl nights/weekends as per bell curve requirements
Additional duties may be assigned as project needs adjust at Management’s discretion.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience (Desired)

Bachelor of Science in Construction Management, or a similar field, or equivalent experience
Construction/Engineering/Architectural degree a plus
5 years of experience in managing construction projects required
Datacenter experience is preferred
Experience in CSA (civil, structural, architectural) and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) construction management is a requirement.

Computer Skills

Competency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams

Proficient in PROCORE

Certificates And Licenses

No certificates or licenses required

Supervisory Responsibilities

Supervise one or more Superintendent or Project Coordinator or Assistant Project Manager

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Occasionally lift and/or move 10 to 50 pounds. Frequently required to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; occasionally required to sit and climb or balance. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust and focus.

Pre Employment Requirements

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment background check, drug screening, and motor vehicle record (MVR) review, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Positions requiring driving must have an MVR that meets company and insurance carrier standards.

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.

Descrizione del ruolo
In qualità di Project Manager presso INTRECCI – Associazione Culturale, la persona selezionata coordinerà e gestirà progetti culturali e artistici, garantendo il rispetto di tempi, budget e obiettivi. Nel lavoro quotidiano sarà responsabile della pianificazione delle attività, del coordinamento del team di progetto e del monitoraggio dell’avanzamento delle iniziative, con una costante attenzione alla qualità dei contenuti e al coinvolgimento del pubblico. Il ruolo prevede la gestione delle relazioni con partner, collaboratori e fornitori, la preparazione della documentazione progettuale e dei report di avanzamento, nonché la supervisione degli aspetti organizzativi e logistici legati agli eventi. Project manager opererà a tempo pieno in modalità remota, collaborando con i diversi referenti dell’associazione attraverso strumenti digitali di comunicazione e gestione dei progetti.
Qualifiche

La persona candidata dovrebbe possedere solide competenze in project management, incluse capacità di pianificazione, gestione delle risorse e controllo dei tempi.
È richiesta familiarità con attività di expeditor ed expediting per garantire il rispetto delle scadenze e il coordinamento efficace tra i diversi soggetti coinvolti.
Sono importanti competenze in inspection e logistics management per monitorare la qualità delle attività e organizzare in modo efficiente i flussi logistici connessi ai progetti.
Costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienza nella gestione di progetti culturali, ottime capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale, padronanza degli strumenti digitali di collaborazione, autonomia operativa e attitudine al lavoro in team.
È gradita una formazione in ambito gestionale, economico, culturale o affini, insieme a una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese e attenzione ai principi di inclusione e pari opportunità.

Experience managing projects for U.S. or other international clients.
Experience working in software development consultancies or agency environments.
Exposure to delivery metrics, capacity planning, or operational performance tracking.
Experience collaborating closely with technical leads or product managers.
Experience working on projects that involved integrations with Generative AI solutions.

🌍 100% remote work from anywhere in Argentina.
🎯 Flexible work hours and remote work opportunities.
📈 Career development and growth opportunities.

💻 Opportunity to work with modern tech and exciting U.S. clients.

jobs.description:
Description

Sr Project Manager - Full Service

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

The Senior Project Manager, Clinical Operations – Full Service is responsible for providing customer-focused leadership in the management and delivery of the operational, financial, and strategic aspects of clinical research projects from proposal development through final deliverables. This role oversees studies ranging from single-service programs to large-scale, full-service global clinical trials across multiple phases and therapeutic areas. The Senior Project Manager serves as the primary client contact, leads cross-functional teams, and ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with quality and regulatory standards.

This position requires a hands-on project manager who is actively involved in study execution and capable of independently leading complex clinical trials with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

Independently manage clinical studies from startup through closeout.
Lead the operational and financial execution of Phase II and III clinical trials, including global and multi-protocol studies.
Act as the primary liaison between sponsors and internal project teams.
Ensure studies are conducted in accordance with GCP, ICH guidelines, regulatory requirements, and company SOPs.
Oversee project timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and deliverables.
Drive day-to-day study execution and proactively identify and resolve project issues.
Coordinate activities across functional teams and external partners to ensure successful project delivery.
Maintain accountability for project quality, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.

Client & Stakeholder Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with sponsors and key stakeholders.
Lead client meetings and provide regular project updates.
Independently prepare and present project materials for internal and external meetings.
Participate in bid defense meetings and business development activities as the designated Project Manager.
Support client growth opportunities through exceptional project delivery and relationship management.

Financial & Operational Oversight

Manage project budgets, forecasting, and financial performance.
Monitor project progress through timelines, metrics, tracking tools, and reporting systems.
Develop risk mitigation and contingency plans to ensure successful project outcomes.
Ensure inspection readiness, including oversight of Trial Master Files and project documentation.
Prepare project reports for sponsors and senior leadership.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

Lead and motivate cross-functional project teams.
Mentor and support junior Project Managers and Project Support staff.
Facilitate project-specific and therapeutic area training as needed.
Promote collaboration, communication, and accountability across teams.

Required Qualifications

Minimum Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of Bachelor’s degree and experience.
Clinical Research Organization (CRO) experience required.
Proven experience independently managing clinical trials from initiation through closeout.
Strong hands-on cross-functional project management experience with direct involvement in study execution.
Experience independently managing project budgets, timelines, resources, and client relationships.
Strong knowledge of GCP, ICH Guidelines, regulatory requirements, and the clinical development process.
Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal, and leadership skills.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel up to approximately 25%.

We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a [possible] upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Salary Range:

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

jobs.title: Land Solutions Project Manager, Electric Transmission, Remote - Wisconsin
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC
is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!
Atwell, LLC
 is a proud recipient of the following 2025
 awards:
Ten consecutive years in a row as a “Best Place to Work” by Zweig Group (#11)
Recognized as #70 in the ENR Top 500 Design Firms, ranked in every region
Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)
Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

Job Description

Atwell is seeking a Land Solutions Project Manager
to support a leading electric transmission client across a portfolio of high-voltage infrastructure and right of way (ROW) projects throughout Wisconsin, with a primary focus on the Green Bay and Milwaukee markets
.
This role is remote
, but candidates located in or near Green Bay or Milwaukee are strongly preferred
due to the need for frequent in-person client engagement, stakeholder meetings, and site visits
. This is a highly visible, client-facing role where your ability to build trust and represent Atwell locally will directly impact project success.
In this role, you will oversee land and ROW acquisition activities supporting electric transmission infrastructure — managing easement negotiations, rights of entry, surface agreements, damage settlements, and fee property transactions across active transmission corridors.
You’ll establish project scope, budgets, and schedules; manage contracts and sub-consultants; and ensure performance metrics are met throughout the project lifecycle.
You’ll also serve as a trusted advisor to the client
, maintaining a consistent presence in the region, staying ahead of their project pipeline, following up on outstanding proposals, and identifying opportunities to expand Atwell’s support. Internally, you’ll manage project documentation in Vision, oversee invoicing and collections, and deliver regular financial and progress reporting to leadership. Coaching and mentoring your project team is a key part of how you operate.
Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, Land Planning, Land Surveying, or equivalent
4+ years of project management experience with a focus on electric transmission, utility infrastructure, or energy-related land and ROW work
Strong background in easement acquisition and land agreements specific to transmission or high-voltage infrastructure projects
Expertise negotiating ROW easements, surface leases, encroachment agreements, rights of entry, fee property, and damage settlements
Familiarity with FERC, state utility commission regulations, and property rights frameworks relevant to transmission development
Experience with Vision as a project management tool
AAPL or SR/WA certification is a plus
Ability and willingness to travel regionally throughout Wisconsin, with a focus on Green Bay and Milwaukee, for client-facing work

Who Thrives Here

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where long-term client relationships and complex land programs intersect. You’re dependable, solutions-oriented, and confident in face-to-face client interactions. You bring a strong local presence, communicate with ease, and understand how to represent both your team and your client in the field.
You recognize the importance of being present — not just available —
and you approach your projects with the accountability and ownership that transmission infrastructure demands. Regional travel is part of the role, and you embrace being on-site when it matters most.
Disclaimer 

While AI tools may support your application process, this role is built on human talent. Your judgment, experience, and character matter most, so we encourage you to showcase what makes you uniquely you.
Atwell does not accept unsolicited resumes from any 3rd party agencies. No fee will be paid to 3rd parties who submit unsolicited resumes to any Atwell employee. Resumes from approved vendors must be specifically requested by Atwell and approved by the Atwell Talent Acquisition Team.

Atwell Benefits:
 To attract and retain the best professionals in the industry, we aim to provide an excellent working environment and a progressive benefits program designed to support your personal and professional needs.
Work/Life:

Generous Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Flexible work schedules are available for some positions
Tenure Awards — Travel Vouchers to see the world based on your travel preferences

Compensation:

Competitive Compensation packages 
Annual bonuses, spot bonuses and peer recognition awards
401K match - 1:1 up to 4% of compensation 
Tuition Assistance
Student Loan Repayment 
Paid Licensing / Certification Fees and Renewals
Financial Rewards for Obtaining Licensure
Employee Referrals 
Annual Wellness Reimbursement for anything wellness related (Gym memberships, fitness tracker, home gym equipment, etc.)
Dependent Care Match

‘Atwell’ness:

Medical (BC/BS), Dental (Delta), and Vision (VSP)
Family Planning & IVF Benefits
Pet Insurance
Health Savings Account & Flex Spending Account options
Employer paid LTD, STD, and life insurance
Metlife Supplemental Benefits covering accident, hospitalization, and critical illness
Member Assistance Program (MAP) with complimentary counseling sessions, legal benefits, financial consultations, and work/life referral services

jobs.description:
Build the future, spark innovation and align your career with purpose.

McKinstry is innovating the waste and climate harm out of the built environment and creating lasting impact. Together, we’re building a thriving planet.

Buildings are a leading contributor to the climate crisis, generating nearly 40% of total global energy-related carbon emissions. We’re making a lasting impact on our industry and within our communities by addressing the climate, affordability and equity crises through:

renewables and energy services
engineering and design
construction and facility services

To get where we’re going, we need big thinkers, problem solvers and collaborative mindsets. Does that sound like you?

The Opportunity with McKinstry

We are adding a Senior Project Manager
to our Data Center Innovations Group. We are looking for someone who likes to develop and manage project plans, schedules, and scopes of work in a fast-paced atmosphere. You will be joining an established and diverse team where you will be able to make an immediate impact. You are someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and are passionate about solving problems and achieving goals. Additionally, some responsibilities you will have include:

Project Management  

Leads projects from initiation to closeout.
Develops and manages project plans, schedules, and scopes of work.
Oversees, scheduling and coordination of internal and external resources for project completion.
Communicates with clients and project resources (subcontractors and vendors).
Documents discussions, outcomes, and decisions.
Supports Request for Proposal (RFP) process. 
Researches and evaluates new products and vendors.
Processes or oversees review log and distributes submittals.
Obtains detailed knowledge of contract, drawings and specifications for project(s).
Maintains or oversees the cost issue logs.
Upholds and communicates McKinstry safety standards.
Ensures safety compliance of subcontractors and all on-site personnel.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Research
jobs.description:
About FirstPrinciples

FirstPrinciples is building AI to accelerate scientific discovery. Our core product is the Theo Platform, a research environment built to help researchers iterate faster, validate rigorously, and reach verified results they can trust.

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

Why This Role Exists

We’re building AI systems at the frontier of scientific discovery, which means research is fundamental to our product advantage. But great research is not just about generating interesting ideas, it’s about directing our time, talent, and compute toward the work most likely to create meaningful scientific and product progress.

This role exists to bring strong product discipline to research execution. You’ll help researchers turn open-ended exploration into clearly framed bets, define how we measure progress and ROI, and create the operating rhythms that let us learn quickly. You’ll push promising work forward with urgency, surface weak signals early, and help teams change direction when an approach is no longer earning its investment.

Your impact will help Research maximize its pace in the organization - more ambitious in what it pursues, more rigorous in how it evaluates progress, and accountable for turning research investment into real product capabilities and breakthroughs.

What You’ll Do

Partner with research leads to define clear research programs, priorities, hypotheses, milestones, and expected outcomes
Operationalize and steward our Research Portfolio & ROI Framework - assessing research bets by ambition, uncertainty, impact, maturity, time horizon, confidence, cost, and product applicability at the program and portfolio level
Establish stage-appropriate evidence plans, KPIs, and leading and lagging indicators for research projects, including signals that increase or reduce confidence, validate progress, or decisively kill a direction
Create operating rhythms that increase the pace of Research: regular reviews, clear owners, intermediate deliverables, decision points, and tight follow-through
Track research initiatives against their objectives and investment, keeping teams accountable for progress while preserving room for genuine scientific exploration
Identify stalled projects, weak assumptions, and diminishing returns early, and drive explicit decisions to iterate, redirect, pause, or stop work rather than allowing projects to drift
Connect research priorities to company, product, and technical strategy, ensuring the research portfolio reflects the capabilities and differentiated advantages we most need to build
Translate research progress into clear decisions, implications, and tradeoffs for Product, Engineering, and leadership, while helping successful research transition into product capabilities, assets, or future strategic options

Who You Are

5+ years as a product manager or program manager in technology or research organizations, comfortable operating in highly technical, ambiguous, and exploratory environments
Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related technical field; ensuring you can comfortably debate technical tradeoffs.
Deep understanding of program management craft and practices, with the ability to guide ambiguous technical programs, make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and apply product thinking where useful without constraining scientific exploration.
Strong bias toward action and learning velocity, where you look for the fastest credible path to determining whether an idea deserves greater investment
Comfortable holding highly technical teams accountable for commitments, decisions, and outcomes while earning trust through intellectual curiosity and sound judgment
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment with a remote-first team.
Motivated by building a research culture that combines scientific ambition with urgency, focus, accountability, and a relentless desire to learn faster

What You’ll Get

The opportunity to work on foundational problems at the intersection of AI and physics
A high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment with real ownership
Remote-first work with flexibility in how you structure your day
Exposure to cutting-edge ideas across AI, scientific discovery, and emerging technologies
A culture that values curiosity, depth of thinking, and first-principles reasoning
The chance to contribute to work aimed at advancing fundamental science

Overview

Organization Summary

At Global Vendor Delivery & Solutions (GVDS), we are transforming how Microsoft delivers business operations at scale. As part of MBO (Microsoft Business Operations), GVDS combines operational excellence, AI-powered innovation, and strategic partnerships to create secure, scalable, and high-performing services across a global vendor ecosystem.

As Microsoft evolves toward a Frontier Firm model, AI, automation, and agentic systems are reshaping how work gets done. GVDS plays a critical role in enabling that transformation by helping operations become more intelligent, adaptive, and outcome-focused. We are looking for leaders who can challenge legacy approaches, accelerate adoption of AI-first ways of working, and build sustainable systems that continuously improve customer and business outcomes.

Role Summary

The AI Transformation & Continuous Improvement Lead is responsible for embedding a culture of continuous improvement across Vendor Operations while accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled operating models. This role serves as a strategic bridge between operations, engineering, service design, and vendor partners to identify opportunities for transformation, eliminate inefficiencies, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Success in this role requires equal parts transformational leadership, operational excellence, and change management. The ideal candidate will build scalable improvement systems, champion AI-driven innovation, and advance Vendor Operations toward a Frontier Firm model that delivers greater quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and business value.

This is not a traditional Continuous Improvement role focused solely on Lean methodologies. It is a transformation leadership role responsible for helping redefine how operations are designed, executed, measured, and continuously optimized in an AI-first world.

Responsibilities

Capability Portfolio Ownership & Feature Management

Own the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, business cases, implementation governance, adoption, benefits realization, and continuous improvement of a portfolio of artificial intelligence-driven operational capabilities.
Maintain accountability beyond deployment to ensure capabilities continue to evolve and deliver measurable business outcomes.

AI Transformation & Frontier Firm Enablement

Lead the adoption of AI-first and agentic operating models across Vendor Operations.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve decision-making through AI-enabled workflows.
Partner with engineering, service design, and operations teams to scale AI and automation capabilities.
Drive operational readiness for Microsoft's Frontier Firm vision.

Continuous Improvement System Deployment

Establish and scale continuous improvement practices across Vendor Operations using Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), Lean, or other structured problem-solving methodologies.
Build repeatable improvement frameworks that create sustainable operational gains.
Facilitate cross-functional improvement initiatives that drive measurable business impact.
Ensure improvements are standardized and institutionalized through governance and operational rhythms.

Operational Excellence & Performance Management

Define and track metrics that reflect customer value, operational efficiency, quality, productivity, and adoption of AI-enabled capabilities.
Develop performance insights that enable leaders to prioritize investments and improvement opportunities.
Create visibility into operational health and transformation progress through data-driven reporting.

Change Management & Organizational Adoption

Lead adoption strategies for new capabilities, operating models, tools, and ways of working, using stakeholder feedback and performance data to guide ongoing capability improvements.
Partner with stakeholders to remove barriers and accelerate behavioral change.
Ensure improvements transition from pilots to sustainable business practices.
Build organizational capability for continuous learning and improvement.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

Serve as a trusted advisor to Vendor Operations leaders on transformation priorities and continuous improvement strategy.
Align stakeholders across Vendor Operations, Engineering, Service Design, and broader MBO initiatives.
Foster knowledge sharing and reuse of best practices across the vendor ecosystem.
Drive organizational alignment around operational excellence and business outcomes.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 4+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

6+ years of experience leading operational transformation, continuous improvement, or business process optimization initiatives in complex global organizations.
Demonstrated success driving measurable improvements in quality, productivity, customer experience, or operational efficiency.
Strong data-driven decision-making skills with experience defining and managing operational performance metrics.
Proven ability to influence organizational boundaries and lead without direct authority. Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Experience owning a portfolio of operational capabilities or features, including strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, business case development, implementation governance, adoption, and benefits realization.
Experience deploying AI, automation, or agentic solutions within operational environments.
Experience implementing structured improvement methodologies such as Lean, PDCA, Kaizen, or related frameworks.
Knowledge of vendor operations, outsourcing models, or large-scale service delivery organizations.
Experience partnering with engineering, product, or service design teams on transformation initiatives.
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles and AI governance considerations.
Certification or experience in Lean Six Sigma or comparable continuous improvement disciplines.

Success Measures

Success In This Role Will Be Measured By

Adoption and scalability of continuous improvement practices across Vendor Operations.
Increased AI-enabled automation and reduction of manual effort.
Improvements in customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Demonstrated business impact from transformation initiatives.

jobs.description:
About UDC 

Ultra Defense Corp (UDC) is a privately held defense company headquartered in Tampa, Florida, with domestic manufacturing facilities and operations supporting American national security interests worldwide.

For more than 15 years, UDC has built a stable and mature organization and is now entering a significant period of expansion. With a recently launched product line aligned with Pentagon priorities in advanced technology and domestic manufacturing, UDC offers the opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment backed by organizational stability and competitive benefits. 

The Opportunity

UDC is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead the development and production of a new product line supporting U.S. Government and commercial small caliber ammunition requirements.
This role will own program execution across production, engineering development, testing, subcontractor performance, quality, safety, cost, schedule, and customer requirements. The Program Manager will also serve as a primary customer-facing representative for active contracts, lead product-related proposal activities, and support business development efforts. 
This is an excellent opportunity for a program leader who can bring together technical and operational teams, drive execution, and operate effectively across a fast-moving defense manufacturing environment.

What You’ll Do

• Lead overall program execution to achieve contract deliverables, production schedules, supplier commitments, quality standards, safety requirements, and key milestones. 
• Manage program cost, budget, and schedule performance, including EAC reviews, spend plans, tracking tools, milestone reviews, and coordination with Finance. 
• Lead program governance and day-to-day execution, including program reviews, action-item tracking, customer IPTs, risk management, and internal/external communications. 
• Drive collaboration across Engineering, Production/Operations, Quality, Safety, Supply Chain, Finance, Business Development, suppliers, and other stakeholders. 
• Guide product development and engineering activities to ensure designs, qualification plans, testing, and design gates remain aligned with customer requirements and program objectives. 
• Apply technical knowledge of small caliber ammunition design, performance, components, and manufacturing to support informed program decisions. 
• Lead proposal efforts for opportunities associated with assigned products, coordinating cross-functional inputs and customer requirements. 
• Serve as a key customer-facing representative for active programs and communicate product capabilities, program status, risks, and customer needs internally and externally. 

What We’re Looking For 

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field. 
• 5+ years of experience as a Program Manager or technical lead. 
• Demonstrated experience managing projects and leading multi-disciplinary teams. 
• Strong program/project management capabilities, including cost, budget, schedule, risk, and milestone management. 
• Experience working across technical, production, supplier, and customer-facing environments. 
• Strong communication, problem-solving, planning, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills. 
• Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience managing defense contracts. 
• Experience leading munitions design and/or production programs. 
• Knowledge of small caliber ammunition design, platforms, components, and manufacturing processes. 
• Experience managing production and product-development programs. 
• Proposal management experience. 
• PMP certification or demonstrated experience applying formal program management principles.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be comfortable providing matrix leadership across multiple functions and locations. You should be able to organize teams, establish priorities, influence resource allocation, create accountability, and keep complex programs moving toward critical milestones—even when team members do not report directly to you. 

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:
Accountability | Collaboration | Communication | Customer Focus | Integrity | Problem Solving | Adaptability | Technical Acumen | Risk Management | Strategic Thinking | Decision Making | Business Acumen

Location & Travel

This position is based in Tampa, Florida and will operate in a hybrid environment, with the expectation that the Program Manager will report to the UDC Tampa office as required.

Periodic travel of approximately 25% is expected to UDC production facilities in Kansas City, Missouri and Marshall, Texas, as well as supplier locations and customer meetings. Initial travel to production locations should be expected.

Additional Requirements

• U.S. Citizenship is required.
• Must be able to successfully complete applicable ATF/BATFE requirements.

Why UDC?

At UDC, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape and execute programs directly supporting U.S. national security while working across engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, and customer organizations.

What UDC Offers

• Competitive Base Salary
• Medical, Dental, Vision, STD, LTD, Life, AD&D
• 401(k) & Company Match
• Company Paid Holidays/Generous PTO
• Professional Development and Advancement Opportunities
• Hybrid Work Opportunity

NVIDIA is redefining what is possible with AI, and we are building the next generation of relational deep learning for enterprise data. We care deeply about turning frontier AI research into reliable products that teams can trust every day, and we are excited to add a Principal Technical Program Manager who will help us do exactly that!

Coordinate closely with infrastructure, systems, and platform groups to align compute capacity, training and serving environments, and platform features that models depend on.
Guide release management for both the platform and models, including experiment‑to‑production hand‑offs, versioning, compatibility, model cards, benchmarks, and safety and compliance approvals.
Maintain the operating rhythm for the program, leading planning, reviews, risk and dependency tracking, and decision forums across research, engineering, data, product, legal, and other partners.
Define and track program health metrics such as model quality, training speed, evaluation coverage, and time‑to‑release, and share clear status, risks, and decisions in executive reviews.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
15+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or data/ML delivery, including significant time in ML/AI or large‑scale data environments.
Experience leading complex, multi‑stakeholder programs end to end in research and engineering organizations, with evolving requirements and clear delivery timelines.
Comfort working with ML researchers, interpreting model and evaluation results, and making decisions about training pipelines, data, and infrastructure trade‑offs.

A hands‑on, builder mindset that includes creating automation and tooling, using AI in daily work, and applying AI to streamline program operations, status reporting, risk detection, and release workflows.

Delivering graph ML, recommender, or fraud‑detection systems into production, or shipping ML platforms and frameworks that other teams build on.

Running programs that span platform and infrastructure teams and model and research teams, including GPU and compute capacity planning for training and serving.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Amazon Now
jobs.description:
Description

We build the customer experience platform behind Amazon's quick commerce businesses, the platform that powers shopping journeys across marketplaces at roughly 700K orders a day. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive platform programs spanning 12+ tenants and 500+ developers as we evolve from a multi marketplace stack into a true multi business platform.

You will own the programs that turn a single business stack into versioned API contracts, a federated front end, and surface agnostic shopping capabilities that any Amazon business can configure into a journey of its own shape. Each tenant brings different needs, and your job is to sequence that work so businesses compose journeys instead of forking the platform.

This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical programs and many stakeholder coordination, who can hold a three year architectural direction while shipping quarter over quarter, and who cares that a page is ready in sub-second at Amazon volume.

Key job responsibilities

Own cross team programs that deliver certified, versioned API contracts and a bring your own API extension path, so new businesses onboard by configuration rather than by forking the stack.
Drive the front end federation program (shell, component registry, tenant packages, build time isolation) across feature teams shipping independently to production.
Coordinate onboarding of new tenants and marketplaces, cutting time to launch from three months toward weeks, and track the platform effort each onboarding costs.
Run the performance, resilience, and observability programs that keep every journey fast and tenant isolated at scale, including interaction budgets, alarm based rollback, and prevention of cross tenant incidents.
Build the mechanisms that govern what earns a place in the shared core versus what stays a business owned extension, resolving competing tenant needs across 12+ clients.
Manage dependencies with partner platforms and drive convergence decisions.
Establish program rhythm across 500+ developers: roadmaps, release schedules, risk and critical path management, and quarterly checkpoints against annual targets.
Translate a three year platform vision into sequenced, committed deliverables with clear exit criteria.

A day in the life

You start with the programs in flight across the platform, unblocking a tenant onboarding here and a contract certification there. You work with multiple senior and principal engineers on architecture tradeoffs, with product managers on which capabilities graduate into the core, and with partner teams on shared dependencies. You keep the performance and resilience bars visible, chase down a latency regression before it crosses tenants, and prep the quarterly checkpoint against annual targets. Your stakeholders span multiple leaders from fast growing businesses WW, and your customers are the Amazon teams building shopping experience using our platform.

About The Team

We currently run the customer experience platform behind Amazon's quick commerce businesses. What began as one team's customer journey stack has grown into a single platform serving multiple marketplaces at roughly 700K orders a day. We are a B2B product whose customers are Amazon businesses, and our mission is to let any of them launch, experiment, and scale a shopping journey without building the stack beneath it. Multiple Amazon businesses came to us organically because the paradigm works. We are now one architectural shape away from becoming the default place a new shopping journey starts at Amazon, and this role helps get us there.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience owning program strategy for a platform, set of APIs, or shared services consumed by multiple internal teams
Experience delivering versioned API contracts, developer facing tooling, or tenant onboarding programs at scale
Experience driving performance, resilience, or observability programs across distributed systems
Experience developing and executing technical roadmaps across many stakeholder teams

Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connected Vehicle Services) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through Sirius XM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

SiriusXM Media
is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America. As the combined advertising revenue organization of Sirius XM Holdings Inc., SiriusXM Media spans across leading owned and operated audio platforms Pandora and SiriusXM; innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz; sonic creative consultancy Studio Resonate; and an extended content network featuring exclusive monetization agreements with Audiochuck, NBCUniversal, SoundCloud, and many more. Reaching more than 150 million listeners each month, SiriusXM Media delivers audiences the tailored brand experiences they crave while putting creators first, making it easy for every marketer to produce, plan, buy and measure across its entire audio universe.

Success in this role will enable AdsWizz to scale globally through the delivery of robust, high-performance advertising platform capabilities that directly support monetization and business growth.

Define program structure, milestones, interdependencies, and success metrics.
Coordinate across multiple engineering teams to ensure cohesive execution across ad-serving systems, data pipelines, and platform services.
Lead cross-domain program reviews and executive updates.

Strategic Alignment & Decision Support

Partner with engineering and product leadership to prioritize initiatives based on business impact and technical feasibility.
Clearly articulate tradeoffs, risks, and execution options to support fast, informed decision-making.
Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related domains.

Technical Depth & Systems Thinking

Apply strong architectural literacy to evaluate system design implications and cross-team dependencies.
Review technical designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively identify downstream impacts.
Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints.

Operational Excellence

Drive improvements in intake, prioritization, and release processes using tools such as Jira.
Enhance transparency around delivery status, risks, and cross-team dependencies.
Establish scalable program management best practices across Ads Engineering.

Serve as the connective layer between Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, and external stakeholders.
Support launch planning, operational readiness, and post-launch learnings.
Provide clear escalation pathways to remove execution blockers quickly.

What You’ll Need

5+ years of technical program management experience leading complex, enterprise-scale initiatives.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Significant experience in advertising technology, including familiarity with ad-serving systems, real-time bidding, monetization platforms, data pipelines, and analytics systems.

At Firestorm, we are building the future of expeditionary defense manufacturing and autonomous systems. Modern conflict has exposed a fundamental problem: the systems needed most by operators are often too expensive, too slow to produce, and too difficult to sustain at scale. Firestorm exists to change that.

We develop mission-adaptable aerial systems and deployable manufacturing infrastructure designed to put capability directly into the hands of the warfighter. From modular unmanned aircraft to xCell — our deployable microfactory — our goal is to make defense systems rapidly deployable, adaptable, and producible at the point of need.

We are looking for builders, operators, and problem-solvers who want to work on meaningful technology with real-world impact.

About The Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager at Firestorm, you will take charge of mission-critical programs that push the boundaries of aerospace and defense technologies. You’ll be responsible for overseeing the end-to-end execution of complex projects, ensuring the seamless integration of technical, schedule, and cost objectives to deliver innovative, high-performance systems.

This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned program manager to influence key decisions, lead cross-functional teams, and drive both innovation and operational excellence in programs that directly impact national security. You will collaborate closely with Business Development, Operations, and Engineering teams, maintaining a strong focus on program execution, customer satisfaction, and delivering cutting-edge technologies that meet the highest standards.

What You'll Do

Create, maintain, and track detailed program schedules, budgets, and resource plans for global programs, guiding them from concept through New Product Introduction (NPI) and full deployment.
Advocate for program resources, budget, and priority, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer expectations.
Monitor and report on program and project status, highlighting key metrics and milestones, and driving accountability across teams.

Negotiate terms related to performance, delivery, and cost with Sales and Business Development, ensuring that all agreements align with program goals.

Work and negotiate with vendors on contracts and agreements to secure necessary resources and services for program execution.
Coordinate planning, preparation, and execution of product demonstrations and test events, showcasing technical capabilities and meeting customer requirements.
Collaborate with Engineering teams to continually improve product offerings, advocating for new features and innovations that will benefit the program and exceed customer expectations.
Lead cross-functional teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

U.S. Citizenship required & the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) security clearance.
Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
7+ years of experience leading and managing complex, technical programs, preferably in aerospace, defense, or electromechanical systems; Or, 9+ years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree).
Proven ability to integrate cost, schedule, and technical baselines for high-impact, cross-functional programs.
Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple teams and maintain stakeholder alignment.

Experience working with UAS and familiarity with DoD standards and regulations.
Ability to refine and develop processes, tools, and templates for more efficient program execution.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to mentor, lead, and motivate teams to success.
Experience with military personnel or defense contractors, particularly in managing complex defense programs.

Occasional travel up to 10% domestically to engage with customers, vendors, and support program milestones.

jobs.description:
Company Background

Our client is an established, family owned international food organization with a long-term approach to investment, innovation and value creation. The organization supplies nutrition, food, systems and services to care markets, including seniors, healthcare and long-term care.

In Canada, the company serves business-to-business markets, including healthcare, long-term care and community-based meal programs, as well as consumers through a home-delivery service for seniors.

The Ottawa production facility operates from a purpose-built food manufacturing site. The facility is federally regulated by the Canadian Food Inspection Agency and operates a HACCP plan. Most business support and head office functions are based at this location.

The Role and the Team

The Program Manager, Value Engineering will lead our client's margin improvement and recipe value engineering program within Product Development. The role will convert commercial priorities into a focused portfolio of initiatives that improve product margin while protecting food safety, quality, nutrition, customer expectations and manufacturing feasibility.

This position has no direct reports. The Program Manager will lead cross-functional resources assigned to the program and will be accountable for setting direction, sequencing work, creating pace and holding contributors to agreed commitments. Success therefore depends on disciplined project leadership, commercial judgement and the ability to influence and challenge constructively without relying on formal authority.

The ideal candidate brings practical food product development experience, strong knowledge of recipe value engineering and a genuine passion for food. They will be equally comfortable in a project review, a cost discussion and a manufacturing trial, and will build trusted relationships across Product Development, Commercial, Procurement, Operations, Quality, Nutrition, Supply Chain and Finance.

The Position

Director Product Development

Direct Reports:
None; resources will be assigned to support program delivery

Key Relationships:
Product Development, Commercial, Procurement, Operations, Quality, Nutrition, Supply Chain and Finance

Location:
Ottawa, Ontario

Key Responsibilities:

Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of margin improvement and value engineering opportunities across the product portfolio.
Lead cross-functional teams through scoping, feasibility, development, trials, validation, approval, implementation and benefits realization.
Translate margin targets and business needs into clear project briefs, deliverables, timelines, decision points and resource requirements.
Direct the work of resources assigned to the program, clarify responsibilities and create accountability without formal reporting authority.
Apply recipe value engineering to ingredients, formulations, specifications, suppliers, pack formats, process design, yield and waste reduction.
Develop fact-based business cases using cost, margin, volume, investment, risk and implementation assumptions; partner with Finance to validate and track benefits.
Balance commercial opportunity with food safety, quality, nutrition, regulatory, customer and operational requirements.
Facilitate project reviews and decision forums, making trade-offs visible and driving timely resolution of risks, dependencies and barriers.
Influence stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively and align teams around recommendations and decisions.
Maintain clear program reporting covering progress, resource demand, risks, decisions, forecast savings and realized results.
Strengthen value engineering tools, governance, documentation and ways of working within Product Development.

The Candidate

Essential Qualifications and Experience

Degree or diploma in food science, food technology or a related discipline.
Minimum of three years of product development experience in food manufacturing, including taking recipe or product changes through development and implementation.
Demonstrated experience in recipe value engineering, cost optimization or margin improvement in a food environment.
Strong project or program management capability across prioritization, planning, governance, risk management and multiple workstreams.
Commercial understanding, including the ability to interpret product costing and margin drivers and build sound business cases.
Experience leading cross-functional teams and directing work without formal authority.
Working knowledge of food safety, quality, regulatory and manufacturing considerations relevant to recipe and process changes.
A genuine passion for food and for creating products that deliver value to customers and the business.

Desirable Qualifications and Experience

Culinary training or professional culinary experience.
Experience in prepared meals, large-scale food production or a similarly complex environment.
Formal project management training or certification.

Highly organized, able to prioritize competing demands and maintain momentum across multiple projects.
Commercially curious, analytical and comfortable using data to support decisions.
Confident communicator who can influence, challenge and build strong stakeholder relationships.
Practical and solutions-focused, with the judgement to balance opportunity, risk and feasibility.
Collaborative and accountable, with the resilience to work through ambiguity and setbacks.

RRSP program.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery.

Job Description

As a Technical PM, you will be responsible for: 1) supply chain coordination of the electronic components and embedded systems of our robots,conduct technical review/QA directly with suppliers. 2) Testing, trouble shooting of power electronics, digital electronics (PCBA validation), firmware, communication protocols, and interfaces on robots. 3）Overseeing small-batch production timeline and quality management with suppliers. 4）Functional calibration and test bench development and set up. 5)Collaborating closely with both the supply chain & manufacturing team in Shanghai and the engineering team in Zurich, you will contribute to ensuring the reliable integration and high performance of the electronic systems in our robots.

We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic, hands-on environment and has a proven track record of bringing electromechanical systems from prototype to production, with a strong focus on quality and supply chain efficiency.

What You’ll Be Doing

Independent supply chain coordination of the electronic components and embedded systems of our robots,conduct technical review/QA directly with suppliers.
Independent Testing and trouble shooting of power electronics, digital electronics (PCBA validation), firmware, communication protocols, and interfaces on robots.
Functional calibration and test bench development and set up.
Collaborate with mechanical engineers to ensure seamless integration of electronics into mechanical assemblies.
Identify, evaluate, select, and manage suppliers for electrical components and subassemblies.
Work closely with suppliers for the transfer of designs and technical documentation.
Perform thorough testing and troubleshooting of electronic and embedded systems.
Support continuous improvement cycles across assembly, testing, and deployment phases.
Document processes, test results, and improvements to ensure traceability and knowledge sharing.
Coordinate with the Zurich R&D team and local suppliers to implement design updates quickly and reliably.
Support design improvements and iteration in the context of manufacturability.

What You Must Have

Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Embedded Systems.
5+ years of hands-on experience in electrical system development, testing, and low-volume manufacturing.
Experience in setting up functional benches for electronic components.
Generate test bench’s test script and test plan.
Experience in the testing, and integration of PCBAs for embedded or robotic systems.
Strong trouble-shooting skills for embedded hardware and firmware.
Familiarity with power distribution, motor controllers, sensors, and communication protocols (CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, etc.).
Familiarity with ROS, embedded Linux, or microcontroller platforms (e.g., STM32, ESP32, etc.).
Familiarity with AI tools that lift work productivity.
Proven track record of working with external suppliers.
Experience with quality control and validation of electrical components and assemblies.
Strong adaptability and comfort with frequent iteration and evolving designs.
Strong communication skill and ability to work in a dynamic team environment.
Fluent in Mandarin and English to effectively navigate local and international interactions

Get some bonus points

Experience in the robotic, automotive, Semi-conductor, and consumer electronics sector.
Experience in startups or fast-paced product development environments.
Experience with compliance testing (EMC, safety, etc.) for robotic or embedded products.

RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.

We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.
