jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role:

Role Purpose

The Security Manager is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and continuous development of the regional shopping centre’s security operation. You will ensure a safe, secure, and welcoming environment for millions of annual visitors, major retail tenants, employees, contractors, and stakeholders across our extensive estate.

This role leads the centre’s approach to protective security, counter-terrorism preparedness, and crisis management, ensuring that safety, emergency, and business resilience arrangements remain proportionate to the threat profile of a massive, high-footfall regional destination.

A critical requirement of this position is extensive knowledge of Martyn’s Law / the Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025. You will hold direct responsibility for ensuring the entire regional estate develops, implements, tests, and maintains robust compliance, emergency response, and operational recovery procedures.

As a visible and credible leader, you will direct the onsite security team, fulfil crucial Duty Management rotations , and collaborate strategically with asset management, national retailers, emergency services, local authorities, and counter-terrorism partners.

Key Responsibilities

Security Strategy & Governance

Strategic Evolution: Develop, own, and review the centre’s overarching security strategy to reflect changing threat environments and large-scale regional operations.
Executive Liaison: Provide professional security advice to the Centre Director, Contracts manager, and the broader senior management team.
Capital & Improvement Planning: Author an annual security improvement plan identifying investment requirements for security infrastructure, emerging risks, and technological opportunities.
Oversight & Compliance: Establish robust security governance, assurance audits, and performance KPIs across the security provision.
Reporting: Deliver comprehensive security, risk, and trend reporting to senior stakeholders.
Threat Horizons: Maintain deep awareness of hostile reconnaissance, crime trends, and vulnerabilities relevant to high-footfall regional hubs and crowded places.
Commercial Balance: Ensure security measures seamlessly blend protective safety with a welcoming, premier retail and leisure experience.

Martyn’s Law, Counterterrorism & Crisis Preparedness

Legislative Lead: Act as the subject-matter expert for Martyn’s Law / Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act requirements, embedding duties across the entire asset.
Gap Analysis: Undertake regular, rigorous gap analyses against legislative mandates, protective security standards, and crisis resilience frameworks.
Public Protection & Crisis Strategy: Ensure comprehensive public-protection and incident response procedures are developed, documented, communicated, and regularly reviewed.
Organisational Readiness: Work alongside senior management to formally demonstrate compliance, crisis capabilities, and strategic readiness to regulatory bodies.
Education & Culture: Ensure all internal employees, service partners, and retail tenants thoroughly understand their responsibilities regarding suspected hostile activity, immediate response protocols, and emergency procedures.
Testing & Exercising: Develop, coordinate, and execute realistic table-top and live-scale crisis and counter-terrorism simulation exercises across the estate.
Audit Trails: Maintain meticulous records and evidence demonstrating compliance, operational readiness, and crisis preparedness.

Duty Management & Centre Oversight

Duty Management Rotations: Participate in the centre’s Duty Manager roster, acting as the primary point of contact and ultimate authority for the entire estate during assigned shifts, including weekends and evenings.
Estate Compliance: Conduct regular Duty Manager estate inspections to monitor and maintain standards across customer service, housekeeping, maintenance, and health and safety.
Incident Escalation & Leadership: Act as the senior representative on the ground to manage and resolve real-time operational issues, customer complaints, and landlord/tenant escalations.
Statutory Compliance: Monitor compliance with the centre’s public health and safety protocols during the shift, ensuring all public areas remain safe, clear, and fully accessible.

Joint Counter-Terrorism Risk & Incident Management

Scenario Modelling: Lead the centre’s approach to risk mitigation and incident response planning for a diverse range of security threats and emergency scenarios.
Proportionate Mitigation: Evaluate likelihood, vulnerabilities, and consequences to implement proportionate preventative physical controls, procedural barriers, and immediate crisis management actions.
Estate Protection: Maintain expert knowledge of Hostile Vehicle Mitigation (HVM), perimeter access control, advanced CCTV systems, search regimes, dynamic lockdown, invacuation protocols, and emergency communications.
External Networks: Partner closely with Counter Terrorism Policing, regional police forces, emergency services, and regional intelligence networks to align incident planning with current guidance.

Security & Resilience Risk Assessments

Risk Ownership: Own and maintain the centre’s overarching Security Risk Assessment.
Targeted Assessments: Develop and update specific risk assessments for counterterrorism, major incidents, high-profile events, and large-scale estate developments.
Operational Integration: Translate complex risk assessments into practical, clear operational controls and emergency checklists for frontline teams.
Vulnerability Management: Identify physical, technological, or procedural vulnerabilities and build formal business cases for infrastructure and resilience improvements.
Change Management: Ensure significant estate alterations, seasonal events, and landlord construction projects receive appropriate security-risk and business-continuity consideration.

SOPs, Policies & Crisis Procedures

Procedural Governance: Lead the development and governance of security Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Emergency Response Plans.
Scope of Procedures: Ensure clear, legally compliant, and regularly exercised SOPs are in place for:
Emergency response, critical incident command, and escalation
Dynamic lockdown, Evacuation, and Invacuation
Threat verification, suspicious items, and hostile reconnaissance
Mass notification, emergency communications, and alert systems
Protest, public disorder, and anti-social behaviour
Mass casualty management and emergency-service collaboration

Crisis Command & Business Resilience

Crisis Command: Take a critical, senior command role within the centre’s incident and crisis-management structure during any major security event.
Operational Control: Ensure effective infrastructure exists for command and control, incident containment, mass emergency communications, and emergency-service integration.
Resilience: Lead business continuity, asset preservation, and operational recovery frameworks following any major incident.
Lessons Learned: Oversee the annual major incident exercise programme, ensuring all identified lessons are formally recorded, assigned, and closed out to continuously improve centre resilience.

Leadership & People Management

Visible Leadership: Provide inspiring, professional leadership across the entire security function, establishing high behavioural standards.
Talent Development: Coach, mentor, and build succession plans for supervisors and future security and crisis leaders.
Accountability: Drive a culture of continuous improvement, challenging poor performance while celebrating excellence.
Purpose-Driven Culture: Ensure all personnel understand not just what emergency procedures require, but the critical why behind them.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Promote seamless communication between security, customer service, housekeeping, maintenance, and the wider centre management team during daily operations and crisis events.

Stakeholder & Partnership Management

Strategic Alliances: Cultivate deep operational relationships with Counter Terrorism Policing, blue-light emergency services, local authorities, and regional Business Crime Reduction Partnerships (BCRP).
Community Engagement: Represent the centre at regional security forums, landlord meetings, and cross-border crisis resilience partnership initiatives.

Essential Experience

Scale & Complexity: Significant senior security and crisis-management experience within a high-footfall, complex environment, specifically a regional shopping centre, major transport hub, stadium, or similar sprawling publicly accessible location.
Duty Management: Proven experience working in a Duty Manager / Centre Management capacity with broad operational oversight beyond security (e.g., managing customer service, facilities escalation, or commercial real estate ops).
Legislation: Deep, demonstrable working knowledge of Martyn’s Law / the Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act and its practical execution within large estates.
Protective Security & Crisis Management: Comprehensive understanding of modern counterterrorism, protective-security, and emergency management principles.
Risk & Policy Management: Proven experience authoring high-quality security risk assessments, emergency plans, scalable SOPs, and crisis protocols.
Exercise Delivery: Track record of designing and delivering major-incident exercises, crisis simulations, and table-top scenarios.
Partnership Working: Extensive experience collaborating with police, Counter Terrorism Policing, and blue-light services.
Technology Proficiency: Strong command of security technologies, including enterprise CCTV networks, access control, mass notification systems, and incident-management software.
Team Leadership: Experience managing large security teams, whether directly employed or via an outsourced specialist security provider.

Leadership Requirements

Presence: A highly confident, credible, and influential senior leader.
Perspective: Strategically minded while maintaining an acute understanding of frontline operational realities and emergency response limits.
Composure: Exceptionally calm, analytical, and decisive under pressure during major critical incidents and broad operational crises.
Constructive Challenge: Comfortable challenging existing practices and senior stakeholders to elevate security, compliance, and crisis readiness standards.
Communication: An exceptional communicator who translates complex security risks and crisis commands into clear, practical operational actions across all levels.

Qualifications & Professional Development

Education: Recognised security or Operations qualification (e.g. NVQ level 5 or 6) or equivalent senior professional experience.
CT Training: Advanced counterterrorism/protective-security and incident command training relevant to publicly accessible locations.
Core Modules: Valid ACT Awareness and ACT Security certifications.
Licensing: Valid SIA Licence appropriate to the senior responsibilities of the role.
Collaboration: Jessip Gold commander course
A willingness to further develop managerial skills and knowledge.

beliefert Blaulichtorganisationen sowie Kunden aus dem Bereich Kritische Infrastruktur seit mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten mit äußerst zuverlässigen Leitstellenlösungen. ESS Real Estate Project Manager

12 months

UK Offices

Role Purpose

The ESS Real Estate Project Manager is accountable for the successful execution of multiple, concurrent real estate projects involving the deployment of EY Global Security enterprise access control and CCTV systems (CCURE & Victor). This position is pivotal in ensuring timely project completion, adherence to technical standards and seamless coordination among stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Manage the Request for Proposal (RFP) process for CCURE & Victor electronic security systems, encompassing vendor engagement and selection.
Develop technical design specifications for security system implementations.
Coordinate installation and integration activities with appointed integrator.
Ensure strict compliance with EY minimum baseline standards, Global security policies and all relevant technical requirements.
Participate in project meetings and facilitate effective communication with stakeholders across Global Technology, Real Estate, contractors, and integrators.
Oversee project milestones to guarantee on-time delivery and uphold quality benchmarks.
Provide oversight of the installation of security systems, ensuring all works are executed to the highest standard and in accordance with project specifications. Monitor progress on site, proactively addressing any issues that may arise during installation to minimise disruption and maintain project timelines
Conduct Threat, vulnerability and risk assessments (TVRA) for new property locations and prepare operational requirements documents to inform security system specifications.

Required Skills & Experience

Extensive and proven experience in project management specifically within the electronic security systems sector, with a strong track record of successfully overseeing the delivery and integration of advanced access control and CCTV platforms in real estate environments.
In-depth knowledge of CCURE & Victor systems or comparable enterprise access control and CCTV products.
Understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and Near Field Communication (NFC) technologies.
Experience conducting Threat, Vulnerability and Risk (TVR) assessments.
Extensive understanding of mobile credential technologies.
Proficiency in managing RFP processes and overseeing vendor selection.
Strong stakeholder management and advanced communication capabilities.
Proven ability to coordinate complex initiatives across diverse teams and external partners.
Familiarity with compliance frameworks applicable to enterprise security platforms, such as:
GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) – governing the protection and privacy of personal data
ISO/IEC 27001 – an international standard for information security management systems (ISMS).
SOC 2 (System and Organisation Controls) – focusing on controls relevant to security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of data.

Platform Administration & Operations

Supervise configuration, monitor system health, and manage the lifecycle of iSTAR controllers and IP cameras deployed across the estate.
Perform regular system audits, diagnose technical issues, and implement firmware or software updates as needed to minimise operational disruptions.
Ensure full compliance with GDPR and other relevant data protection regulations, upholding exemplary standards of privacy and regulatory conformity throughout all data handling and system operations.

System Integration & Projects

Lead the integration of CCURE 9000 with Victor/VideoEdge and other third-party security solutions to ensure cohesive interoperability and efficient data flow.
Plan and deliver system upgrades, migrations, and expansion projects, collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, vendors and appointed integrators.
Develop and sustain thorough technical documentation, including system design diagrams, configuration records, and detailed user guides.

Infrastructure

Oversee administration of Windows Server environments and Active Directory to facilitate secure and reliable system operations and user access management.

Collaborate with network infrastructure teams to establish robust connectivity and effective network segmentation for all security platforms.
Work closely with other departments to ensure cybersecurity hardening measures are applied and ensure best practices are followed on every platform, reviewing configurations to reduce vulnerabilities and address emerging threats.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC Insurance is deploying modern, AI- and data-driven fraud detection across its insurance business, integrating enterprise RBC fraud capabilities with insurance-specific detection and investigation built in-house on our cloud data platform.

We're hiring a Senior Program Manager, Fraud Intelligence Solution. You'll own the plan, the operating rhythm, and the outcomes: detection running in production, used daily by investigators, governed to regulatory standards, improving quarter over quarter.

This is a technical delivery role. The right candidate has built data and AI capabilities, data platforms, ML scoring pipelines, model deployment, inside a regulated financial institution, and can review code, prototype with AI tools, and challenge architecture and modeling decisions credibly. Fraud is the application domain, not the required expertise. This is not a general program management role: data and AI fluency is a gate, not a nice-to-have.

What will you do?

Lead delivery. Run several delivery teams and a program function. Dated plans, firm checkpoints, quarterly quality targets. Raise alerts and replan when dates slip.
Ship into production. Detection running, investigators using it daily, regulatory requirements met. Build the data foundation for sophisticated detection over time.
Navigate complexity. Drive approvals ahead of the critical path, manage enterprise-partner dependencies, coordinate roadmaps, handle escalations.
Make trade-offs. Arbitrate scope and quality, balancing technical complexity against business value. The program builds on existing platforms, judge when to reuse, when to buy, when building is justified.
Stay technical. Review architecture and scoring designs, read code, prototype with gen AI, challenge modeling and platform decisions.
Partner with the business. Work with claims specialists and investigators, translate their expertise into requirements, prioritize what gets built.
Communicate upward. Represent status, risks, and decisions to senior executives in business terms.

What will you need to succeed?

Must have

Deep working knowledge of cloud data platforms, data engineering pipelines, and ML scoring systems (feature pipelines, supervised models, deployment and monitoring). You can evaluate a scoring architecture and challenge modeling trade-offs. Hands-on SQL/Python within the last 5 years, or equivalent technical depth demonstrable in review.
8+ years in data platform, ML, or AI product delivery (not general program management), including 4+ years leading multi-team delivery (10+ people).
Demonstrated delivery in a regulated financial institution. You've personally navigated architecture governance, model risk management, and security review, and can speak concretely about planning around them.
Experience with mixed-mode delivery: hard-milestone workstreams alongside iterative capability development, in an organization that is not natively agile.
Organizational acumen with strong central functions (data science, architecture, risk). You influence without deferring on substance or escalating every disagreement.
Experience managing dependencies on platform teams or external partners whose roadmap you do not control.

Nice to have

Snowflake, dbt, graph data platforms, or document AI.
OSFI Guideline E-23 or equivalent model risk frameworks (SR 11-7, ECB TRIM).
Standing up or scaling an investigation or operations function alongside a technology build.
Insurance domain knowledge, or fraud/financial crime/investigation experience in any financial services context.

What’s in it for you?

RBC Insurance is an organization that succeeds by bringing out the best in its people. You’ll be part of a supportive, inclusive team that shares common values – including a fundamental respect for each other. At the heart of this is a commitment to diversity. RBC respects and responds to the many competing and evolving priorities in our lives – so you can focus on what you can do best – putting clients first.

A Total Rewards program that includes flexible benefits, work/life balance and career development programs and investment and retirement savings plans

All the tools, training, and team support you need to grow your business and career

Undergraduate Degree, or relevant experience

Work-life balance

jobs.title: Information Technology Project Manager
jobs.description:
Our client, a well-known electric vehicle manufacturer that develops off-road and utility vehicles is hiring an IT Project Manager to join their joint venture system engineering team in Palot Alto, CA.

Our client has built an arm of the business that partners with other OEMS to design and build a shared software platform and electrical architecture for electric vehicles. This team needs an IT Project Manager to help map and integrate internal IT systems. Currently, the systems across both OEM's are not well documented and rely on individual knowledge. As a Project Manager, you would help document and map system integrations and build knowledge base articles. The ideal candidate would have previous experience leading end-to-end system architecture, permissions and governance, and building intake forms.

** This is not a "build" project manager role.**

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree or related field
6+ years of recent software project management experience
End-to-end system integration and system mapping experience
Strong system documentation and knowledge base management experience
Experience creating technical intake forms
Experience presenting and working with stakeholders

What You Will Do:

System inventory.
A complete register of IT systems used across the OEM's interface
Understand purpose, owner on each side, hosting model, data flows, integration points, licensing and contract references.
Architecture and configuration documentation.
Per system and end to end: network topology and routes, firewall rules and IP allowlists, VPN and proxy paths, DNS, authentication and identity model, user and group structures, role definitions, and joiner-mover-leaver handling.
Data protection documentation.
GDPR records of processing for the interface systems, controller/processor roles, DPAs and transfer mechanisms for EU–US flows, data classification and retention mapping, and the control evidence relevant to the RVT TISAX scope.
Stakeholder map.
Named roles on both sides for each system: business owner, technical owner, security, data protection, procurement, escalation path, and current de-facto contacts where these differ from the formal ones.
Support process concept.
Intake channels, ticket categories, severity definitions, response and resolution targets, escalation ladder with named contacts, on-call expectations, and the interfaces to existing VWG and RVT service desks.
Stakeholder alignment.
The concept reviewed and signed off with owners on both sides, with dissent and open points documented rather than smoothed over.
Handover to Enterprise IT.
Runbooks, working sessions, a transition checklist, and a defined acceptance point at which Enterprise IT owns the process.
Criticality assessment.
Identification of critical systems and single points of failure, with concrete measures (redundancy, documented workarounds, named backups for key people, monitoring gaps) to make support sustainable beyond the contract.

jobs.title: Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d) - Aerospace/Defence
jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎

As a Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d), you will play a crucial role in driving project success and contributing to the growth and efficiency of our organization. Your ability to lead, collaborate, and deliver results will be essential in achieving our strategic objectives and exceeding client expectations. The position can be filled on any Kuehne+Nagel location in the EMEA region.

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d) to lead and oversee complex global customer implementation projects and programs from initiation to successful stabilization within a defined business vertical. As part of the vertical PMO, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects on time, within scope, and within budget. You will collaborate with the related vertical leadership teams on the Sales side and the Business Unit Air Logistics side to develop vertical related strategic goals and best practice to continuously meet the market requirements and conditions of our customers. This role requires at least 5 years of experience in leading/driving large, complex projects and/or programs through complete project Life-cycle, preferably on an international basis and a solid operational background in Air Logistics.

How you create impact

Project Planning and Initiation: Lead project definition, scope, and objectives by collaborating with stakeholders. Create detailed plans, including timelines, resource and risk management
Project Execution and Control: Guide teams, ensuring alignment with goals. Monitor progress, address deviations, and maintain proactive issue resolution
Resource Management: Allocate and secure resources, collaborating with functional managers for expertise and success
Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships, communicate status, be transparent and highlight opportunities effectively
Quality Assurance: Ensure deliverables meet Kuehne+Nagel and ISO 21205 standards, conduct evaluations, and suggest and implement improvements
Competence & Strategy: Collaborate closely with the stakeholders of the assigned PMO vertical within the Sales and Business Unit Air Logistics organization to develop and lead strategic internal projects to further grow the success of vertical specific implementation management
Risk & Change Management: Identify and mitigate risks, manage scope changes professionally for successful integration
Mentoring/Supervision: Serve as a patient mentor, coaching, sharing best practices, fostering learning, and guiding junior managers on the assigned vertical requirements

What we would like you to bring

Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration or a related field
Min. 5 years of proven experience as a Project Manager and/or Program Manager, with a track record of successfully delivering complex global projects in the assigned business vertical
Strong understanding of Air Logistics operation and processes
Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide cross-functional teams
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
Proficiency in project management tools and software
Project Management Professional (PMP, PMI, Prince2) or equivalent certification is a plus

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel, you get to grow your expertise, shape processes and deliver innovative solutions. We are continuously building our local and global network and our product portfolio, creating career opportunities in different fields of work worldwide. As a leader in the logistics industry, we provide a collaborative and IT-driven environment where you will work with motivated and customer-centric colleagues across the world. We look forward to receiving your comprehensive online application.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

, das Geschäft der HSBC Continental Europe S. A. Germany weiterzuentwickeln und auszubauen.

Strategische Kundenbegleitung (Advisory), Schulung und Unterstützung unserer Kunden rund um GPS Client Connectivity, Electronic Banking und zugehörige Zahlungsverkehrsdienstleistungen
Strukturierte Umsetzung und Begleitung komplexer lokaler und internationaler Implementierungen im Kundenumfeld (inkl. Koordination aller relevanten Workstreams)

Begleitung und Koordination von Tests auf Kunden- und Bankseite (z. B. Programm-/Schnittstellentests, Format- und Prozessklärungen) bis zur Go-Live-Readiness
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern (z. B. Coverage, Sales, Service, Product, Operations, IT/Tech) für eine reibungslose End-to-End-Implementierung

Abgeschlossene bankfachliche Ausbildung und/oder Studium (z. B. Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Fundierte Kenntnisse im Zahlungsverkehr/Cash Management sowie idealerweise in Electronic Banking/Connectivity (Schnittstellen, Formate, Testvorgehen)

Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der ziel- und aufgabengerechten Strukturierung und Steuerung komplexer Implementierungs-/Projektvorhaben

Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und sicheres Auftreten, hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung; sehr gutes Englisch sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office (PM-Tools von Vorteil)

Auch wenn Sie der Meinung sind, dass Sie nicht 100% der Anforderungen erfüllen, ermutigen wir Sie sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie glauben, dass diese Stelle die richtige für Sie ist.

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Teilzeitoptionen

Sehr gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch gezielte Weiterbildungsprogramme

Great American’s culture is built on connection, shared learning, and strong relationships. Analyzes, evaluates, and interprets large volumes of complex data from diverse sources to drive strategic business initiatives
Ensures data integrity and accuracy through rigorous validation, reconciliation, and business-focused quality checks.

Advanced proficiency in SQL and relational database concepts.
Strong experience developing business intelligence solutions using Tableau, Power BI, or comparable platforms; Tableau experience preferred.
Experience using Python or other scripting languages for analytics, automation, or data exploration.

Montreal, QC

What You'll Do

Monitor security alerts, dashboards, tickets, reports, and real-time communication channels for potential security incidents.
Perform initial triage and analysis of security events, identify false positives, and determine incident severity and priority.
Escalate confirmed security incidents and assist with containment and mitigation activities.
Partner with internal stakeholders and third-party security providers to investigate and respond to alerts and incidents.
Monitor and analyze SIEM platforms to identify threats and security issues requiring remediation.
Develop and tune SIEM detection rules and alerting policies.
Investigate potential intrusion attempts, suspicious activity, malware events, and other cybersecurity threats.
Accurately document investigations, findings, and response actions within a ticketing system.
Contribute to the ongoing improvement of security monitoring and incident response capabilities.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), threat detection, or incident response environment.
Experience investigating security events and performing incident triage in a mid-to-large enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience with technologies such as: SIEM platforms
IDS/IPS solutions
Network and host-based firewalls
Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools

Understanding of common attack techniques including network scanning, DDoS attacks, malware activity, and unauthorized access attempts.
Experience with scripting or automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Strong understanding of networking concepts including IP, DNS, HTTP, routers, and switches.
Curiosity and passion for investigating the root cause of security incidents.

Nice to Have

Experience with malware analysis, phishing investigations, cloud security, threat hunting, or deception technologies.
Exposure to detection engineering and SIEM rule development.
Experience working in a 24x7 security operations environment.

jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring Information Security Analysts to join our team, blending traditional security analysis with AI-driven workflows to protect Hudl's global operations. In this role, you’ll design agentic workflows, tune detection engines and lead active response efforts to handle security threats directed against Hudl.

As An Information Security Analyst, You’ll

Orchestrate AI and build prompts. You'll develop high-performing prompts and design multi-step agentic workflows that ingest, enrich and correlate security data. You’ll continuously tune agent behaviors to keep outputs accurate, consistent and practical.
Investigate and respond to threats. You’ll maintain prompt libraries for playbooks, generate clear incident summaries and guide containment efforts. As a core member of our 24/7/365 on-call and incident response team, you’ll own security issues through resolution.
Automate detections and prioritize vulnerabilities. You'll optimize phishing engines, refine EDR logic to reduce noise and use agentic workflows to analyze and prioritize vulnerability exposures.
Track metrics and partner across teams. You’ll track key performance indicators and risk metrics for senior leadership while partnering with Security Engineering to plug visibility gaps.

Location

Time spent collaborating with other Hudlies in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently prioritizing applicants within commuting distance of Lincoln or Omaha, Nebraska. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

Experienced. You have 2–3 years of relevant information security experience, including exposure to modern programming languages and DevOps building blocks.
Versed in security frameworks. You have a strong understanding of OWASP and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks.
A strong communicator. You can distill complex incidents into clear, actionable documentation and present findings confidently to leadership.
A team player. You handle multiple projects with ease, jump in during incidents, and care about keeping Hudlies and our products safe.
Organized multitasker. You can prioritize your workload and manage multiple security projects at the same time.

Nice-to-Haves

Certified. You hold one or more security or privacy certifications (such as SC2, SANS or AWS).
Tech and cloud savvy. You have familiarity with modern programming languages, DevOps building blocks and hands-on experience with AWS AgentCore, Security Logging or Lambda.
Tooling experience. You have experience working with CSPM and vulnerability management tools.

Our Role

Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
Support your mental and physical health. We care about our employees’ wellbeing. Our Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups and fitness partner Peerfit have you covered.
Cover your medical insurance. We have multiple plans to pick from to ensure you’ll have the coverage you (and your dependents) want, including vision, dental, fertility healthcare and family forming benefits.
Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that’s free money. We’ll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below— starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$76,000 - $127,000 USD

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Job Summary And Responsibilities

As our Program Manager of Infection Prevention ,
you will help our facility’s patients, personnel, and visitors maintain a safe environment by coordinating all infection prevention and surveillance activities so they can benefit from a healthcare setting protected from the transmission of diseases and infections.

Every day you will assess, develop, and operationalize programs, policies, and procedures to address the infection prevention needs of the facility. You will be expected to conduct regular surveillance rounds, lead root cause analyses for healthcare-associated infections, ensure compliance with federal, state, and CMS regulations, and provide expert consultation and education to clinical staff and hospital committees.

To be successful in this role you must possess strong analytical and communication skills, maintain current knowledge of infection prevention professional society guidelines, and hold a valid Certification in Infection Control (CIC). You must also demonstrate the ability to effectively manage multiple projects, work collaboratively with hospital administration and diverse staff, and provide data-driven recommendations to support quality patient care.

Responsible for the oversight of daily operations of the infection Prevention Department in regards to the facility compliance with Hospital Accreditation Standards, State and CMS regulations.
Ongoing assessment and development of programs, policies and procedures, and forms to address the infection prevention needs of employees, volunteers, contract workers, independent contractors, physicians, registry workers and students in accordance with the guidelines established by the regulatory agencies.
Works in collaboration with Hospital Administration to develop and manage an Infection Prevention Program that incorporates essential facility strategic plan elements that align with the goals, objectives, and risk assessments of the Infection Prevention Program.
Develops and operationalizes the Infection Prevention Program’s annual risk assessment, annual plans, and annual evaluations. Identifies and implements updates to the Infection Prevention Program when new regulations and /or professional guidelines are published.
Ensures all functions of the Infection Prevention Program are conducted including surveillance, rounds to inpatient and outpatient units including perioperative, procedural and ancillary departments, and mandatory reporting to local and state health departments, NHSN, CMS, etc.
Maintains current knowledge of infection prevention professional society guidelines, best practices and regulatory requirements as demonstrated by attending infection prevention conferences and workshops, reviewing current infection prevention literature, guidelines and national standard and networking with Health System and external Infection Prevention Specialists.

Job Requirements

Required

Bachelor's degree in a healthcare related field and five (5) years of experience OR Associates Degree in a healthcare related field and seven (7) years of experience
Three (3) years of experience as an Infection Preventionist in an acute care facility
Certified in Infection Control (CIC) within 24 months of hire

Where You'll Work

Founded in 1967, Dignity Health - Mercy San Juan Medical Center is a 377-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital located in Carmichael, California. Serving over 100,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including a Level II Trauma Center, Level III NICU, heart care, cancer care, women’s health, and neurology. Additionally, Mercy San Juan Medical Center has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. It is a Comprehensive Stroke Center, the highest level of stroke care certification awarded by The Joint Commission.

jobs.title: Business Data Analyst SME Operations
jobs.description:
Als Data Analyst binnen SME Operations help je operationele data om te zetten in inzicht, actie en verbetering. Je werkt nauw samen met operationele teams en stakeholders om businessvraagstukken te begrijpen en te vertalen naar analyses die betere besluitvorming ondersteunen.

Jouw rol als Business Data Analyst SME Operations

Hoewel rapportages en dashboards nog steeds onderdeel zijn van de functie, ligt de nadruk steeds meer op analytics in plaats van op het maken van dashboards. Je identificeert patronen, knelpunten, trends en oorzaken, en helpt SME Operations slimmer en proactiever met data te werken. Daarnaast onderzoek je hoe AI-tools en -technieken kunnen bijdragen aan snellere analyses, betere voorspellingen en efficiëntere manieren van werken.

Je combineert analytisch denkvermogen met businessinzicht: je bent niet alleen geïnteresseerd in wat de data laat zien, maar vooral in wat dit betekent voor operationele prestaties, klantervaring en procesverbetering. Binnen KPN SME Operations werk je mee aan het verbeteren van service, efficiëntie en klantresultaten door betere sturing en meer inzicht. Je maakt deel uit van een team dat de operatie helpt te groeien van beschrijvende rapportages naar voorspellende en diagnostische analytics.

Je werkt samen met collega’s uit de operatie, procesmanagement en andere data- en transformatieteams om inzicht te creëren in prestaties en verbetermogelijkheden. Jouw werk draagt bij aan besluitvorming over volumes, capaciteit, productiviteit, kwaliteit, klantreisprestaties en operationele effectiviteit. Daarnaast help je mee aan het verder professionaliseren van de analytics-capaciteit binnen SME Operations door data-analyse, automatisering, storytelling en AI-ondersteunde inzichten te combineren.

Bij KPN geloven we in samenwerking, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering. Door verschillende perspectieven en expertise samen te brengen, creëren we betere inzichten en betere resultaten voor onze klanten en collega’s. Binnen SME Operations speelt data een belangrijke rol in het verbeteren van service, het verminderen van complexiteit en het ondersteunen van betere besluitvorming. Deze functie is een belangrijke schakel in die ontwikkeling.

Onze focusgebieden

Analyse van operationele prestaties
Trend- en root cause-analyses
Forecasting en capaciteitsinzichten
Verbetering van processen en klantreizen
Automatisering van terugkerende analyses en rapportages
AI-ondersteunde analytics en inzichtgeneratie
Datakwaliteit en consistentie
Heldere en actiegerichte managementinformatie

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Analyseren van operationele prestaties, trends en afwijkingen binnen SME Operations
Vertalen van businessvragen naar data-analyse en bruikbare inzichten
Ontwikkelen, onderhouden en verbeteren van rapportages en dashboards waar nodig
De focus verschuiven van handmatige rapportage naar geautomatiseerde en inzichtgedreven analytics
Signaleren van oorzaken, knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden in operationele processen
Gebruikmaken van AI-tools en -methoden ter ondersteuning van analyse, samenvatting en patroonherkenning
Samenwerken met stakeholders om de juiste KPI’s en managementinformatie te definiëren
Bevindingen helder en overtuigend presenteren aan operationele en managementdoelgroepen
Verbeteren van datakwaliteit, rapportageconsistentie en analytische betrouwbaarheid
Bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van een datagedreven cultuur binnen SME Operations

Je werkt met tools en methoden zoals: Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python, AI-ondersteunde analysetools, Databricks of vergelijkbare analyticsplatformen, en automatiserings- en workflowtools.

Dit is je team

De afdeling Service en Delivery: SME Operations, biedt een inspirerende werkomgeving met volop ruimte voor innovatieve ideeën, creativiteit en feedback – allemaal met als doel onze klanten op de meest efficiënte manier de beste service te bieden. Je komt terecht in een dynamisch en leerzaam team, binnen een Operations-afdeling van ongeveer 200 collega’s.

Wat breng

jij ons?

Jij hebt:

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in data-analyse, business intelligence of operationele analyse.
Uitstekende SQL-vaardigheden voor het extraheren, transformeren en analyseren van data.
Ruime ervaring met BI- en datavisualisatietools zoals Tableau, Power BI of vergelijkbare platforms.
Aantoonbare expertise in statistische analyse, datamodellering, databasebeheer en datawarehousing-concepten.
Gedegen kennis van operationele processen en supply chain- of logistiek management.
Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met het vermogen complexe data te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten voor zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.
Uitstekende communicatie- en presentatievaardigheden en gevorderde kennis van Microsoft Excel voor data-analyse en rapportage.
Zelfstandig kunnen werken, meerdere projecten tegelijk kunnen managen en beschikken over sterke organisatorische, tijdmanagement- en detailgerichte vaardigheden.

Bij voorkeur:

Ervaring als vakspecialist op het gebied van bedrijfsvoering of analyse
Bekendheid met projectmanagementmethodieken en -tools
Ervaring met Python of R voor gegevensanalyse en automatisering

Wat krijg je

van ons?

Natuurlijk hebben we als werkgever jou ook veel te bieden. Dit krijg je van ons:

Een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 5216,- en maximaal € 7843,- afhankelijk van je werkervaring, op basis van 40 uur exclusief 8% vakantiegeld
Vaste 13e maand, een deel krijg je maandelijks uitbetaald en een deel in januari van het volgende jaar. Óf je zet het in voor een FLEX & BOOST doel naar keuze! Klik hier om er meer over te lezen
Jaarlijks een individuele en collectieve verhoging conform onze CAO
€ 1500 per jaar aan inzetbaarheidsbudget dat je naar eigen inzicht mag gebruiken voor bijvoorbeeld trainingen, coaching en cursussen
Flexibele vrije dagen: onze collega’s mogen zelf (in samenspraak met de manager) bepalen hoe zij met verlof omgaan
Een goede werk-privé balans (zoals 2 dagen kantoor, 3 dagen thuis, transitieverlof, feestdagwissel naar een feestdag van jouw religieuze of culturele voorkeur)
Thuiswerkshop om je werkplek thuis optimaal in te kunnen richten, uiteraard met een mobiele telefoon & laptop
50% korting op onze producten en diensten, zodat je voordelig kunt internetten, bellen én streamen
Goede reiskostenvergoeding: je krijgt je OV kosten volledig vergoed of € 0,23 per kilometer als je met de auto reist. Kom je liever op de fiets? Dan kun je aanspraak maken op onze fietsvergoeding € 0,40 per kilometer
Mogelijkheid tot het aanschaffen van een leasefiets waar KPN maandelijks aan meebetaalt (bij onbepaalde tijd contract): Van stadsfiets tot e-bike en van racefiets tot speed-pedelec; jij kiest waar je op fietst
Uitstekende pensioenvoorwaarden: een totale inleg van 25% van je pensioengevende salaris waarvan KPN 17,5% inlegt en jij 7,5%

Ons geloof in technologie is groot. Dit wordt nóg krachtiger samen met menselijk contact, daarom ontmoeten we je graag!

to join our team. This is a hybrid opportunity based out of Waltham, MA.

Job Summary

The Principal Sales Operations Analyst is an integral role on the GTM -Sales Operations team. The role contributes to the growth and expansion of the CRO function at Imprivata. This role is highly visible and key to driving critical strategic initiatives for the sales organization. As a Senior Analyst, you will turn ambiguous problems into actionable solutions. This role is responsible for identify opportunities, align across cross-functional stakeholders, conduct data analytics, bookings forecasting, pipeline analysis, deal structuring and partnering with sales leadership.

Duties And Responsibilities

Provide actionable analysis on key sales KPIs, including forecast accuracy, pipeline quality, deal movement, booking trends, ARR, average deal size, discounting, and quarterly performance drivers.
Partner directly with sales leaders, including RVPs and frontline leadership, to support business reviews, forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and performance discussions.
Analyze pipeline coverage, pipeline creation, stage-level health, and conversion trends to identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improved sales execution.
Own deep-dive analysis of pipeline funnel performance across lead, opportunity, stage progression, conversion, and closed-won outcomes.
Analyze SDR performance, productivity, efficiency, and KPI trends, including activity quality, meeting creation, conversion to opportunity, pipeline contribution, and handoff effectiveness.
Evaluate funnel and deal-stage movement, including stage conversion, time spent in each stage, progression trends, deal slippage, push rates, aging pipeline, and stalled opportunities.
Identify bottlenecks across the sales cycle and recommend data-driven actions to improve pipeline velocity, conversion, quality, and revenue predictability.
Recommend and help implement process improvements, automation, dashboard enhancements, and operating cadences that improve sales efficiency and funnel transparency.
Drive alignment across teams on pipeline definitions, KPI measurement, handoff processes, funnel performance, and action plans to improve results.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that modernize pipeline management, improve forecast accuracy, enhance funnel visibility, and strengthen GTM operating discipline.
Mentor junior analysts and model strong analytical rigor, business acumen, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement practices.
Other duties as assigned and required.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field (MBA preferred).
8-10+ years' experience in revenue operations, sales strategy, or revenue growth roles, with at least 5 years in a leadership position.
Deep knowledge of sales funnels, demand generation, and revenue lifecycle management.
Solid data-analytical skills, with experience in CRM platforms (Salesforce) and revenue intelligence tools.
Proven ability to improve sales processes and revenue forecasting.
Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Experience working in technology, or enterprise sales environments.
Expertise in sales automation, lead scoring, and account-based marketing (ABM).
Ability to drive alignment between marketing, sales, and customer success teams.
Effective problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence.

This position offers a total compensation range of $164,00.00 to $174,000.00 (inclusive of base salary and variable compensation, such as bonuses and incentives). In addition, more information about Imprivata’s benefit offerings can be found here. This range represents the high and low end of Imprivata’s compensation range for this position. Actual compensation will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, such as a candidate’s location, skills, experience, and qualifications.

jobs.description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

At the Discover Global Payment Network, data is the engine that powers our core platforms and products. As a Principal Associate, Data Analysis within the Platform Operations Tower, you will be one of the architects responsible for transforming massive, high-volume transactional data streams into core analytical assets and insights for various domains. You will work on data strategy, architecture, and modeling frameworks for core network platforms, value-added services, and servicing portals in partnership with product and business analysis team members.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

Basic Qualifications

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 2 years of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 2 years of experience delivering Data Governance and Data Quality Management concepts and practices within the financial services industry

jobs.description:
Position: Data Analyst

Reports to: Senior Lead, Data Management
Employment Type: Permanent, full-time
Salary: $70,200–$81,900 per annum ($36.00–$42.00 per hour based on 1,950 hours), plus vacation pay
Benefits: Comprehensive group benefits and private pension plan
Location: Hybrid (remote and on-site)
Work Environment: Inclusive, innovative, and growth-oriented culture at the forefront of laboratory referral testing.
Primary Focus:  Enterprise data operations and system integrations; SQL Server ETL and automation; reporting and analytics; data quality, security, and healthcare privacy.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support enterprise data operations, system integrations, and reporting across business, clinical, and laboratory teams. This hands-on role works with Microsoft SQL Server, business intelligence tools, automated data processes, and secure data transfers in a healthcare environment where data accuracy, reliability, and privacy are essential.

If you enjoy working with data, troubleshooting complex issues, and developing reliable solutions, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful operational impact in healthcare.

Key Areas of Responsibility:
Support daily data operations and ensure timely, accurate data delivery.
Perform data and order corrections in the Lab Information System (LIS) and related systems.
Monitor and audit data transfers and automated processes.
Write, optimize, and maintain SQL and T-SQL queries, procedures, and views.
Develop and maintain Power BI and SSRS reports and dashboards.
Investigate and resolve data quality, integration, reporting, and system issues.
Support ETL pipelines, scheduled data jobs, and automated processes.
Support KPI, operational, and management reporting.
Work with stakeholders to translate business and reporting requirements into reliable data solutions.
Maintain documentation for data processes, integrations, reporting logic, and system changes.
Ensure appropriate handling and protection of Personal Health Information (PHI).
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, automation, reporting, and operational efficiency.

Hands-on Experience Needed to Excel in This Role:
Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
SQL and T-SQL for data analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting.
SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).
Power BI, including datasets, data refresh, publishing, and access control.
Microsoft Excel and Power Query.
Data correction and troubleshooting within LIS and related systems.
Secure file transfers using SFTP and other file-based exchange methods.
Automation, monitoring, and recovery of scheduled data jobs.
SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and ETL processes is an asset.
Scripting or programming using PowerShell, Python, C#/.NET, or similar technologies is an asset.

Qualifications
:

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, or Health Informatics or an equivalent combination of education and hands-on experience.

Experience:
Proven experience supporting SQL Server data, reporting, and integration environments.
Strong SQL/T-SQL skills, including query optimization, performance tuning, and data validation.
Experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and datasets.
Experience with data integrations, ETL processes, and file-based data transfers.
Experience working with sensitive or confidential data in a regulated environment.
Familiarity with PHIPA and the handling of Personal Health Information (PHI).
Experience using a Laboratory Information System (LIS) is an asset.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a time-sensitive operational environment.

Key Competencies:
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proactive approach to troubleshooting and issue resolution.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong documentation and organizational skills.
Ability to work across data, reporting, integration, and enterprise systems.
Strong commitment to data security, privacy, and confidentiality.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Why Join ICL?

﻿ At In-Common Laboratories (ICL), we are dedicated to transforming lives through innovative healthcare and community support services.
Meaningful mission with real health sector impact.
Collaborative, supportive executive leadership.
Opportunities to make an immediate impact, optimize operations, and expand your expertise.

Selection Process Transparency
Artificial intelligence is not used to screen, assess, or select applicants.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Equal Opportunity & Accessibility
ICL is an equal opportunity employer. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request.

The University of Virginia's number one ranked Department of Student Health and Wellness (SHW) provides a comprehensive range of medical, mental health, well-being, and disability support services to all enrolled undergraduate and graduate students. The University of Virginia’s Student Health and Wellness Administration, a unit within the Department of Student Health and Wellness, is seeking a Data Analyst.

This multi-faceted position reports to the programming manager and collaborates with team members to do all things data. Create forms, codes and other objects for data collection. Our team has the vital task of keeping the Electronic Medical Record [EMR] application accessible to our diverse users. Your work will support the doctors, nurses and therapists who provide UVA students with excellent care.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Data Analyst will develop technical architecture and automation support to regional and global GE Vernova Consulting Services team. This role employs a data-centric solutions approach to transform raw power system datasets into high-fidelity actionable insights, enhancing our tactical and strategic market position through robust analytical pipelines.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Infrastructure Management: Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT/ETL (Extract, Transform, Load/Extract Transform, Load) pipelines to ingest and transform high-frequency grid data, ensuring data integrity and lineage.
Data Pipeline Automation: Develop advanced Python scripts for data orchestration, automating the extraction of simulation results from production cost and capacity expansion models (e.g., PlanOS, PLEXOS).
Data Modelling & Warehousing: Manage relational database schemas (PostgreSQL) and implement data-lake architectures to optimize storage and query performance for complex power system time-series data.
Visualization & Business Intelligence (BI): Design and develop high-performance interactive dashboards using Power BI or Tableau that translates complex technical data into clear, actionable insights for key decision-makers. Should be able to use PowerBI, Co-pilot and AI agents to create reports.
Collaborate with power systems engineers to bridge the gap between simulation outputs and front-end visualization, ensuring seamless integration of grid reliability and economic metrics.
Innovation: Actively contribute to GE Vernova’s internal data-driven business initiatives, promoting a culture of high-quality data engineering and technical innovation.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related quantitative field.
2-5 years of relevant experience, with proficiency on Python-based automation, database management (PostgreSQL or similar), and sophisticated data visualization.
Demonstrated proficiency in building end-to-end ELT workflows and managing large-scale datasets, preferably within the energy or utility sector.
Expertise in Power BI, including advanced data modelling (schemas), data analysis optimization, and Direct Query/Import strategy management.
Strong analytical skills with an ability to manage multiple complex data priorities across different regions simultaneously.
Passion for solving challenging technical problems in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Desired Characteristics

Knowledge of power market modelling, simulation tools (e.g., PlanOS or similar), and an understanding of electric power system fundamentals is a plus.
Proficiency in Cloud data environments (e.g., Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
Active participation in industry professional data or engineering societies.
Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related quantitative field.

Additional Information

jobs.title: Market Research Analyst III
jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the role?

We are looking for a Senior Market Researcher who can influence marketing decision-making by translating rigorous brand and performance marketing research into clear insights that sharpen channel execution and audience strategy. You’ll work closely with marketing teams and alongside other researchers and data scientists to deliver recommendations that will craft the future of human commerce on Etsy.

This is a full-time position reporting to the Senior Manager, Market Research.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

The Market Research team helps Etsy understand customers, sellers, and the marketplace through rigorous qualitative and quantitative research
We use research to inform the development of marketing strategy & tactics and to help evaluate marketing performance (in close partnership with Marketing Analytics)
We’re a mixed-methods team with a deep bench of quantitative and qualitative methods, but our team leans towards quantitative skill sets
We conduct research with global consumers, small business owners, as well as Etsy buyers & sellers
We actively foster an inclusive team culture that promotes diversity, collaboration, and professional development

What does the day-to-day look like?

Partner with Brand Marketing and Performance Marketing teams to guide marketing strategy and execution.
Independently develop and execute research for widely-scoped problem spaces, including writing briefs, developing survey instruments, analyzing data, generating insights and recommendations, writing reports, and socializing results.
Own key aspects of our holistic brand measurement program and channel & audience strategy, including partnering with Analytics teams to design and maintain robust brand measurement frameworks.
Own stakeholder relationships to share findings and prioritized recommendations to drive Etsy’s marketing and business goals
Source and synthesize secondary research, including competitive intelligence.
Contribute to market research operations, including project management and overseeing the process of working with third-party research vendors (e.g., research agencies, moderators).
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

Approximately 5+ years experience conducting primary market research, ideally in a multi-channel marketing or ecommerce environment
Expertise designing and executing quantitative and mixed-methods research, including brand tracking, audience strategy, channel measurement
Strong quantitative research skills, including sampling, questionnaire design, and data analysis, with the ability to develop measurement frameworks, interpret complex data from primary research and third-party sources, identify meaningful trends, and translate findings into clear business implications
Experience connecting brand health, channel performance, audience understanding, and business outcomes to development holistic measurement approaches and inform marketing strategy
Comfort leveraging AI tools to accelerate research workflows and experience independently exploring new use cases– while maintaining human oversight and judgement of outputs
Excellent data visualization skills, including experience with Google Slides, with the ability to translate complex data into clear narratives
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills,
A collaborative, curious, and pragmatic mindset and the ability to balance methodological rigor with speed and proactively identify opportunities for research and measurement to improve marketing decisions

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

Geo-1: 138,000.00 - 186,000.00 USD Annual
Geo-2: 124,000.00 - 168,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

jobs.description:
Company

Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta

As an employee of the Atlanta Fed, you will help support our mission of promoting the stability and efficiency of the U.S. economy and financial system. Your work will affect the economy of the Southeast, the United States, and the world. The work we do here is important, and how we do it is just as important as what we do. We live our values of integrity, excellence, and respect every day. We do the right thing, we do things right, and we treat people right. A career at the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta gives you the chance to do work that touches lives and helps communities prosper.

The Bank believes in flexibility to balance the demands of work and life while also recognizing the necessity of connecting and collaborating with our colleagues in person. Onsite work is an essential function of this position, and you are required to be onsite according to the schedule set by your management

As a Research Analyst (RA) at the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta you will play a critical role in our economic research and policy projects. Candidates for RA positions should have a strong background in advance economic and mathematic courses during their studies.

The staff of the Economics Research Department at the Atlanta Fed advises on monetary policy and conducts innovative analysis and research on a variety of topics, including macroeconomics and monetary policy, applied microeconomics and finance. For more information, please refer to our website.

Qualifications:

Motivated and exceptional college graduates with a strong academic record in economics, mathematics, finance, statistics, computer science, or in related fields.
Proficiency with at least one statistical software package or programming language (e.g. Stata, R, Python, SQL, Julia or Matlab).
Strong communication skills and extensive experience working collaboratively.
Experience in working with micro data is a plus.

Responsibilities:

RAs assist staff economists in the analysis of current public policy issues and events including topics such as monetary policy, the state of the US and global economy, development in financial and housing markets, etc. This may include running and maintaining financial, banking and macroeconomic forecasting models or preparing background material for briefings with the Atlanta Fed president.
RAs assist staff economists in their research activity, allowing them to work on a broad array of applied and theoretical topics. Most RAs will provide statistical and computational analysis to support staff economists.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS:
To be considered, all applications must include:

Resume
Cover Letter (please discuss your research interests)
Undergraduate Transcript (unofficial is acceptable)
Graduate Transcript if applicable (unofficial is acceptable)
Academic writing sample

IMPORTANT NOTE: When asked to upload your resume on the Workday Portal, you must upload all supplementary application documents. There will not be an additional prompt to upload documents 2 3, & 4. You must upload them on the same page where you upload your resume. Failure to do so will result postponing the review of your application.

Frequently Asked Questions

What areas of research will I be working on?

The Economics Research Department at the Atlanta Fed has three sections: Macroeconomics and Monetary Policy, Applied Microeconomics and Finance. Each section has a specific research agenda with economists working on a broad variety of research topics. The specific topics you will be working on will depend on the economists you will be working with.

Do I need a strong background in computer programming?

While we do not require knowledge in specific programming languages, we do require successful candidates to have basic proficiency in at least one programming language or statistical package. We, furthermore, require candidates to be able and willing to learn new languages quickly depending on the requirements of their specific position.

What benefits does the Atlanta Fed offer?

The Atlanta Fed offers an employer-matching 401(k) savings plan; commuter subsidy program; health, dental and vision insurance; and tuition reimbursement for individual courses, certificate programs, and graduate programs. For details, please refer to our website.

What opportunities are there for career development and continued learning?

Training in software, such as Stata, R, Python, SQL, Julia or Matlab
Attend seminars by Atlanta Fed and visiting economists
Working closely with Ph.D. economists
The Atlanta Fed offers a tuition reimbursement for coursework and degree programs at nearby universities.

Is this a long-term job?

RAs typically stay at the Atlanta Fed for 2-3 years before leaving to pursue graduate studies or other professional work.

Are non-U.S. citizens eligible for hiring?

Bank policy specifies that candidates must be eligible to work in the United States on a continuous basis for other than practical training purposes. In some cases, positions require access to confidential supervisory information or Federal Open Market Committee data, which is limited to “protected individuals” as defined in U.S. federal immigration law. Protected individuals include, but are not limited to, U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents who are not yet eligible to apply for naturalization, and U.S. permanent residents who have applied for naturalization within six months of being eligible to do so.

Where is the Atlanta Fed located?

The Atlanta Fed is located at 1000 Peachtree St NE, Atlanta, GA 30309.
