The Senior Project Manager, Clinical Operations – Full Service is responsible for providing customer-focused leadership in the management and delivery of the operational, financial, and strategic aspects of clinical research projects from proposal development through final deliverables. This role oversees studies ranging from single-service programs to large-scale, full-service global clinical trials across multiple phases and therapeutic areas. The Senior Project Manager serves as the primary client contact, leads cross-functional teams, and ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with quality and regulatory standards.

This position requires a hands-on project manager who is actively involved in study execution and capable of independently leading complex clinical trials with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

Independently manage clinical studies from startup through closeout.
Lead the operational and financial execution of Phase II and III clinical trials, including global and multi-protocol studies.
Act as the primary liaison between sponsors and internal project teams.
Ensure studies are conducted in accordance with GCP, ICH guidelines, regulatory requirements, and company SOPs.
Oversee project timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and deliverables.
Drive day-to-day study execution and proactively identify and resolve project issues.
Coordinate activities across functional teams and external partners to ensure successful project delivery.
Maintain accountability for project quality, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.

Client & Stakeholder Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with sponsors and key stakeholders.
Lead client meetings and provide regular project updates.
Independently prepare and present project materials for internal and external meetings.
Participate in bid defense meetings and business development activities as the designated Project Manager.
Support client growth opportunities through exceptional project delivery and relationship management.

Financial & Operational Oversight

Manage project budgets, forecasting, and financial performance.
Monitor project progress through timelines, metrics, tracking tools, and reporting systems.
Develop risk mitigation and contingency plans to ensure successful project outcomes.
Ensure inspection readiness, including oversight of Trial Master Files and project documentation.
Prepare project reports for sponsors and senior leadership.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

Lead and motivate cross-functional project teams.
Mentor and support junior Project Managers and Project Support staff.
Facilitate project-specific and therapeutic area training as needed.
Promote collaboration, communication, and accountability across teams.

Required Qualifications

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC
is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!
Atwell, LLC
 is a proud recipient of the following 2025
 awards:
Ten consecutive years in a row as a “Best Place to Work” by Zweig Group (#11)
Recognized as #70 in the ENR Top 500 Design Firms, ranked in every region
Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)
Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

Job Description

Atwell is seeking a Land Solutions Project Manager
to support a leading electric transmission client across a portfolio of high-voltage infrastructure and right of way (ROW) projects throughout Wisconsin, with a primary focus on the Green Bay and Milwaukee markets
.
This role is remote
, but candidates located in or near Green Bay or Milwaukee are strongly preferred
due to the need for frequent in-person client engagement, stakeholder meetings, and site visits
. This is a highly visible, client-facing role where your ability to build trust and represent Atwell locally will directly impact project success.
In this role, you will oversee land and ROW acquisition activities supporting electric transmission infrastructure — managing easement negotiations, rights of entry, surface agreements, damage settlements, and fee property transactions across active transmission corridors.
You’ll establish project scope, budgets, and schedules; manage contracts and sub-consultants; and ensure performance metrics are met throughout the project lifecycle.
You’ll also serve as a trusted advisor to the client
, maintaining a consistent presence in the region, staying ahead of their project pipeline, following up on outstanding proposals, and identifying opportunities to expand Atwell’s support. Internally, you’ll manage project documentation in Vision, oversee invoicing and collections, and deliver regular financial and progress reporting to leadership. Coaching and mentoring your project team is a key part of how you operate.
Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, Land Planning, Land Surveying, or equivalent
4+ years of project management experience with a focus on electric transmission, utility infrastructure, or energy-related land and ROW work
Strong background in easement acquisition and land agreements specific to transmission or high-voltage infrastructure projects
Expertise negotiating ROW easements, surface leases, encroachment agreements, rights of entry, fee property, and damage settlements
Familiarity with FERC, state utility commission regulations, and property rights frameworks relevant to transmission development
Experience with Vision as a project management tool
AAPL or SR/WA certification is a plus
Ability and willingness to travel regionally throughout Wisconsin, with a focus on Green Bay and Milwaukee, for client-facing work

Who Thrives Here

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where long-term client relationships and complex land programs intersect. You’re dependable, solutions-oriented, and confident in face-to-face client interactions. You bring a strong local presence, communicate with ease, and understand how to represent both your team and your client in the field.
You recognize the importance of being present — not just available —
and you approach your projects with the accountability and ownership that transmission infrastructure demands. Regional travel is part of the role, and you embrace being on-site when it matters most.
Disclaimer 

While AI tools may support your application process, this role is built on human talent. Your judgment, experience, and character matter most, so we encourage you to showcase what makes you uniquely you.
Atwell does not accept unsolicited resumes from any 3rd party agencies. No fee will be paid to 3rd parties who submit unsolicited resumes to any Atwell employee. Resumes from approved vendors must be specifically requested by Atwell and approved by the Atwell Talent Acquisition Team.

Atwell Benefits:
 To attract and retain the best professionals in the industry, we aim to provide an excellent working environment and a progressive benefits program designed to support your personal and professional needs.
Work/Life:

Generous Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Flexible work schedules are available for some positions
Tenure Awards — Travel Vouchers to see the world based on your travel preferences

Compensation:

Competitive Compensation packages 
Annual bonuses, spot bonuses and peer recognition awards
401K match - 1:1 up to 4% of compensation 
Tuition Assistance

Financial Rewards for Obtaining Licensure

To get where we’re going, we need big thinkers, problem solvers and collaborative mindsets. Does that sound like you?

The Opportunity with McKinstry

We are adding a Senior Project Manager
to our Data Center Innovations Group. We are looking for someone who likes to develop and manage project plans, schedules, and scopes of work in a fast-paced atmosphere. You will be joining an established and diverse team where you will be able to make an immediate impact. You are someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and are passionate about solving problems and achieving goals. Additionally, some responsibilities you will have include:

Ensures safety compliance of subcontractors and all on-site personnel. 

Project Controls

Delivers accurate and timely data to support project forecasts. 

Communicate

Inform internal and external customers of new offerings and upgrades.
Facilitate communication internally between project team and other departments.
Make presentations to a variety of audiences; act as subject matter expert.
Identify, qualify and funnel potential new service opportunities to Business Development team.
Directs customer requests for product functionality enhancements to the appropriate people. 

Team Management

Recruits, coaches, and mentors project team members.
Develop project staffing plans to include labor and subcontractors.
Responsible for the forecasting of project management labor requirements.
Act as steward of McKinstry culture; communicate and influence policies and procedures.
Other duties as assigned.

What You Need To Succeed At McKinstry

Must have demonstrated proficiency for all the responsibilities of a Project Manager.
BA/BS degree in Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, Facilities Management or equivalent work experience required. 
Eight (8) years of experience in project management, building operations or other related field required.
Experience with working for a General Contractor or Major Mechanical Subcontractor required. 
Proficient in scheduling software: Microsoft Project, Primavera, and/or Suretrak required. 
Knowledge of construction management, commercial building process, financial acumen
Intermediate working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and Project required; working knowledge of SharePoint preferred.
RCDD, CPM professional designation is preferred.
Knowledge of construction financial programs and software.
Basic estimating skills preferred. 
Knowledge of the basics of labor relations including union contract requirements, and hiring practices preferred. 

PeopleFirst Benefits

When it comes to the basics, we have you covered:

Competitive pay 401(k) with employer match and profit-sharing plan
Paid time off and holidays
Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision with low or zero deductible options and low out of pocket maximum.

Family formation benefits, including adoption and IVF assistance

Transgender inclusive benefits

new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager – Infrastructure & Cloud
new_jobs.description:
Our client, a national general contractor in the construction and engineering industry, is modernizing its enterprise content management and IT operations environment. This includes migrating off a legacy shared network drive to a governed cloud content platform, maturing configuration and asset management practices, and strengthening service desk and disaster recovery capabilities. We're looking for a technically fluent Project Manager to lead this portfolio of infrastructure and cloud initiatives from planning through execution.

This role is remote-based but requires you to live near one of our client's office locations, with occasional travel expected. We're open to candidates based near any of the following areas: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Concord, CA; Dallas, TX; Denver, CO; Los Angeles, CA; New York, NY; Portland, OR; Sacramento, CA; San Diego, CA; San Francisco, CA; Santa Ana, CA; Santa Clara, CA; or Seattle, WA. Candidates near Sacramento, Concord, or Denver are especially encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Own the project plan, schedule, resourcing, risk log, and status reporting across a multi-phase enterprise content and cloud migration program.
Lead platform selection, architecture design, migration sequencing, and legacy system decommissioning.
Coordinate cross-functional dependencies (Legal, Risk, Security, Infrastructure, Digital Workplace, Finance) and escalate blockers through governance forums.
Lead build-out of configuration management database (CMDB) and asset management capabilities, including data model and ownership.
Improve service desk intake, incident, and request management processes and connect them to accurate configuration data.
Update disaster recovery plans and business impact analyses; establish a quarterly DR testing program.
Maintain consistent monthly status reporting and present progress, risks, and decisions to technology governance forums.
Manage the portfolio plan in a project portfolio management tool and drive stakeholder communications and change management.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of IT project management experience, including infrastructure or cloud programs in an enterprise environment with 1,000+ users.
Led at least one content, file storage, or data center migration end to end - sequencing, cutover, and decommissioning.
Hands-on experience implementing IT service management and CMDB capabilities in Freshservice or an equivalent platform.
Experience developing disaster recovery plans, business impact analyses, and recurring testing programs.
Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and cloud infrastructure concepts sufficient to lead technical teams and vendors.
PMP or equivalent project management certification.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to report to executives and translate technical work into business terms.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
Experience in construction, engineering, or another field-based industry with distributed job sites and mobile workers.
Prior SharePoint or document management platform migration experience, including migration tooling and permission remediation.
Familiarity with Microsoft Purview, records management, and legal hold capabilities.
Experience running programs through formal governance - steering committees, stage gates, executive reporting.
Experience leading organizational change management for technology rollouts.

Tools & Environment

Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Freshservice (ITSM/CMDB), a project portfolio management tool, and general cloud infrastructure platforms.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You're technically fluent enough to lead infrastructure, cloud, and IT service management work without needing a long ramp-up, and disciplined about governance and reporting. You're comfortable moving a distributed set of stakeholders - Legal, Risk, Security, Infrastructure, Finance - through decisions, and you operate well within formal governance structures like steering committees and stage gates without letting process slow you down.

This position will require a pre-employment background check and drug test to be administered by the clients preferred partners. All screening is required to be completed prior to start but will not be conducted until an offer has been made.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Research
new_jobs.description:
About FirstPrinciples

FirstPrinciples is building AI to accelerate scientific discovery. Our core product is the Theo Platform, a research environment built to help researchers iterate faster, validate rigorously, and reach verified results they can trust.

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

Why This Role Exists

We’re building AI systems at the frontier of scientific discovery, which means research is fundamental to our product advantage. But great research is not just about generating interesting ideas, it’s about directing our time, talent, and compute toward the work most likely to create meaningful scientific and product progress.

This role exists to bring strong product discipline to research execution. You’ll help researchers turn open-ended exploration into clearly framed bets, define how we measure progress and ROI, and create the operating rhythms that let us learn quickly. You’ll push promising work forward with urgency, surface weak signals early, and help teams change direction when an approach is no longer earning its investment.

Your impact will help Research maximize its pace in the organization - more ambitious in what it pursues, more rigorous in how it evaluates progress, and accountable for turning research investment into real product capabilities and breakthroughs.

What You’ll Do

Partner with research leads to define clear research programs, priorities, hypotheses, milestones, and expected outcomes
Operationalize and steward our Research Portfolio & ROI Framework - assessing research bets by ambition, uncertainty, impact, maturity, time horizon, confidence, cost, and product applicability at the program and portfolio level
Establish stage-appropriate evidence plans, KPIs, and leading and lagging indicators for research projects, including signals that increase or reduce confidence, validate progress, or decisively kill a direction
Create operating rhythms that increase the pace of Research: regular reviews, clear owners, intermediate deliverables, decision points, and tight follow-through
Track research initiatives against their objectives and investment, keeping teams accountable for progress while preserving room for genuine scientific exploration
Identify stalled projects, weak assumptions, and diminishing returns early, and drive explicit decisions to iterate, redirect, pause, or stop work rather than allowing projects to drift
Connect research priorities to company, product, and technical strategy, ensuring the research portfolio reflects the capabilities and differentiated advantages we most need to build
Translate research progress into clear decisions, implications, and tradeoffs for Product, Engineering, and leadership, while helping successful research transition into product capabilities, assets, or future strategic options

Who You Are

5+ years as a product manager or program manager in technology or research organizations, comfortable operating in highly technical, ambiguous, and exploratory environments
Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related technical field; ensuring you can comfortably debate technical tradeoffs.
Deep understanding of program management craft and practices, with the ability to guide ambiguous technical programs, make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and apply product thinking where useful without constraining scientific exploration.
Strong bias toward action and learning velocity, where you look for the fastest credible path to determining whether an idea deserves greater investment
Comfortable holding highly technical teams accountable for commitments, decisions, and outcomes while earning trust through intellectual curiosity and sound judgment
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment with a remote-first team.
Motivated by building a research culture that combines scientific ambition with urgency, focus, accountability, and a relentless desire to learn faster

What You’ll Get

The opportunity to work on foundational problems at the intersection of AI and physics
A high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment with real ownership
Remote-first work with flexibility in how you structure your day
Exposure to cutting-edge ideas across AI, scientific discovery, and emerging technologies
A culture that values curiosity, depth of thinking, and first-principles reasoning
The chance to contribute to work aimed at advancing fundamental science

Organization Summary

At Global Vendor Delivery & Solutions (GVDS), we are transforming how Microsoft delivers business operations at scale. As part of MBO (Microsoft Business Operations), GVDS combines operational excellence, AI-powered innovation, and strategic partnerships to create secure, scalable, and high-performing services across a global vendor ecosystem.

As Microsoft evolves toward a Frontier Firm model, AI, automation, and agentic systems are reshaping how work gets done. GVDS plays a critical role in enabling that transformation by helping operations become more intelligent, adaptive, and outcome-focused. We are looking for leaders who can challenge legacy approaches, accelerate adoption of AI-first ways of working, and build sustainable systems that continuously improve customer and business outcomes.

Role Summary

The AI Transformation & Continuous Improvement Lead is responsible for embedding a culture of continuous improvement across Vendor Operations while accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled operating models. This role serves as a strategic bridge between operations, engineering, service design, and vendor partners to identify opportunities for transformation, eliminate inefficiencies, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Success in this role requires equal parts transformational leadership, operational excellence, and change management. The ideal candidate will build scalable improvement systems, champion AI-driven innovation, and advance Vendor Operations toward a Frontier Firm model that delivers greater quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and business value.

This is not a traditional Continuous Improvement role focused solely on Lean methodologies. It is a transformation leadership role responsible for helping redefine how operations are designed, executed, measured, and continuously optimized in an AI-first world.

Responsibilities

Capability Portfolio Ownership & Feature Management

Own the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, business cases, implementation governance, adoption, benefits realization, and continuous improvement of a portfolio of artificial intelligence-driven operational capabilities.
Maintain accountability beyond deployment to ensure capabilities continue to evolve and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve decision-making through AI-enabled workflows.
Partner with engineering, service design, and operations teams to scale AI and automation capabilities.
Drive operational readiness for Microsoft's Frontier Firm vision.

Build repeatable improvement frameworks that create sustainable operational gains.
Facilitate cross-functional improvement initiatives that drive measurable business impact.
Ensure improvements are standardized and institutionalized through governance and operational rhythms.

Create visibility into operational health and transformation progress through data-driven reporting.

Ensure improvements transition from pilots to sustainable business practices.
Build organizational capability for continuous learning and improvement.

About UDC 

Ultra Defense Corp (UDC) is a privately held defense company headquartered in Tampa, Florida, with domestic manufacturing facilities and operations supporting American national security interests worldwide.

For more than 15 years, UDC has built a stable and mature organization and is now entering a significant period of expansion. With a recently launched product line aligned with Pentagon priorities in advanced technology and domestic manufacturing, UDC offers the opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment backed by organizational stability and competitive benefits. 

The Opportunity

UDC is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead the development and production of a new product line supporting U.S. Government and commercial small caliber ammunition requirements.
This role will own program execution across production, engineering development, testing, subcontractor performance, quality, safety, cost, schedule, and customer requirements. The Program Manager will also serve as a primary customer-facing representative for active contracts, lead product-related proposal activities, and support business development efforts. 
This is an excellent opportunity for a program leader who can bring together technical and operational teams, drive execution, and operate effectively across a fast-moving defense manufacturing environment.

What You’ll Do

• Lead overall program execution to achieve contract deliverables, production schedules, supplier commitments, quality standards, safety requirements, and key milestones.

• Lead program governance and day-to-day execution, including program reviews, action-item tracking, customer IPTs, risk management, and internal/external communications. 
• Drive collaboration across Engineering, Production/Operations, Quality, Safety, Supply Chain, Finance, Business Development, suppliers, and other stakeholders. 
• Guide product development and engineering activities to ensure designs, qualification plans, testing, and design gates remain aligned with customer requirements and program objectives. 
• Apply technical knowledge of small caliber ammunition design, performance, components, and manufacturing to support informed program decisions. 
• Lead proposal efforts for opportunities associated with assigned products, coordinating cross-functional inputs and customer requirements. 
• Serve as a key customer-facing representative for active programs and communicate product capabilities, program status, risks, and customer needs internally and externally. 

What We’re Looking For 

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field. 
• 5+ years of experience as a Program Manager or technical lead. 
• Demonstrated experience managing projects and leading multi-disciplinary teams. 
• Strong program/project management capabilities, including cost, budget, schedule, risk, and milestone management. 
• Experience working across technical, production, supplier, and customer-facing environments. 
• Strong communication, problem-solving, planning, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills. 
• Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of small caliber ammunition design, platforms, components, and manufacturing processes. 
• Experience managing production and product-development programs.

You should be able to organize teams, establish priorities, influence resource allocation, create accountability, and keep complex programs moving toward critical milestones—even when team members do not report directly to you. 

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:
Accountability | Collaboration | Communication | Customer Focus | Integrity | Problem Solving | Adaptability | Technical Acumen | Risk Management | Strategic Thinking | Decision Making | Business Acumen

Location & Travel

This position is based in Tampa, Florida and will operate in a hybrid environment, with the expectation that the Program Manager will report to the UDC Tampa office as required.

Periodic travel of approximately 25% is expected to UDC production facilities in Kansas City, Missouri and Marshall, Texas, as well as supplier locations and customer meetings. Initial travel to production locations should be expected.

Own cross team programs that deliver certified, versioned API contracts and a bring your own API extension path, so new businesses onboard by configuration rather than by forking the stack.

Build the mechanisms that govern what earns a place in the shared core versus what stays a business owned extension, resolving competing tenant needs across 12+ clients.
Manage dependencies with partner platforms and drive convergence decisions.

new_jobs.description:
About The Role:

Role Purpose

The Security Manager is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and continuous development of the regional shopping centre’s security operation. You will ensure a safe, secure, and welcoming environment for millions of annual visitors, major retail tenants, employees, contractors, and stakeholders across our extensive estate.

This role leads the centre’s approach to protective security, counter-terrorism preparedness, and crisis management, ensuring that safety, emergency, and business resilience arrangements remain proportionate to the threat profile of a massive, high-footfall regional destination.

A critical requirement of this position is extensive knowledge of Martyn’s Law / the Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025. You will hold direct responsibility for ensuring the entire regional estate develops, implements, tests, and maintains robust compliance, emergency response, and operational recovery procedures.

As a visible and credible leader, you will direct the onsite security team, fulfil crucial Duty Management rotations , and collaborate strategically with asset management, national retailers, emergency services, local authorities, and counter-terrorism partners.

Key Responsibilities

Security Strategy & Governance

Strategic Evolution: Develop, own, and review the centre’s overarching security strategy to reflect changing threat environments and large-scale regional operations.
Executive Liaison: Provide professional security advice to the Centre Director, Contracts manager, and the broader senior management team.
Capital & Improvement Planning: Author an annual security improvement plan identifying investment requirements for security infrastructure, emerging risks, and technological opportunities.
Oversight & Compliance: Establish robust security governance, assurance audits, and performance KPIs across the security provision.
Reporting: Deliver comprehensive security, risk, and trend reporting to senior stakeholders.
Threat Horizons: Maintain deep awareness of hostile reconnaissance, crime trends, and vulnerabilities relevant to high-footfall regional hubs and crowded places.
Commercial Balance: Ensure security measures seamlessly blend protective safety with a welcoming, premier retail and leisure experience.

Martyn’s Law, Counterterrorism & Crisis Preparedness

Legislative Lead: Act as the subject-matter expert for Martyn’s Law / Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act requirements, embedding duties across the entire asset.
Gap Analysis: Undertake regular, rigorous gap analyses against legislative mandates, protective security standards, and crisis resilience frameworks.
Public Protection & Crisis Strategy: Ensure comprehensive public-protection and incident response procedures are developed, documented, communicated, and regularly reviewed.
Organisational Readiness: Work alongside senior management to formally demonstrate compliance, crisis capabilities, and strategic readiness to regulatory bodies.
Education & Culture: Ensure all internal employees, service partners, and retail tenants thoroughly understand their responsibilities regarding suspected hostile activity, immediate response protocols, and emergency procedures.
Testing & Exercising: Develop, coordinate, and execute realistic table-top and live-scale crisis and counter-terrorism simulation exercises across the estate.
Audit Trails: Maintain meticulous records and evidence demonstrating compliance, operational readiness, and crisis preparedness.

Duty Management & Centre Oversight

Duty Management Rotations: Participate in the centre’s Duty Manager roster, acting as the primary point of contact and ultimate authority for the entire estate during assigned shifts, including weekends and evenings.
Estate Compliance: Conduct regular Duty Manager estate inspections to monitor and maintain standards across customer service, housekeeping, maintenance, and health and safety.
Incident Escalation & Leadership: Act as the senior representative on the ground to manage and resolve real-time operational issues, customer complaints, and landlord/tenant escalations.
Statutory Compliance: Monitor compliance with the centre’s public health and safety protocols during the shift, ensuring all public areas remain safe, clear, and fully accessible.

Joint Counter-Terrorism Risk & Incident Management

Scenario Modelling: Lead the centre’s approach to risk mitigation and incident response planning for a diverse range of security threats and emergency scenarios.
Proportionate Mitigation: Evaluate likelihood, vulnerabilities, and consequences to implement proportionate preventative physical controls, procedural barriers, and immediate crisis management actions.
Estate Protection: Maintain expert knowledge of Hostile Vehicle Mitigation (HVM), perimeter access control, advanced CCTV systems, search regimes, dynamic lockdown, invacuation protocols, and emergency communications.
External Networks: Partner closely with Counter Terrorism Policing, regional police forces, emergency services, and regional intelligence networks to align incident planning with current guidance.

Security & Resilience Risk Assessments

Risk Ownership: Own and maintain the centre’s overarching Security Risk Assessment.
Targeted Assessments: Develop and update specific risk assessments for counterterrorism, major incidents, high-profile events, and large-scale estate developments.
Operational Integration: Translate complex risk assessments into practical, clear operational controls and emergency checklists for frontline teams.
Vulnerability Management: Identify physical, technological, or procedural vulnerabilities and build formal business cases for infrastructure and resilience improvements.
Change Management: Ensure significant estate alterations, seasonal events, and landlord construction projects receive appropriate security-risk and business-continuity consideration.

SOPs, Policies & Crisis Procedures

Procedural Governance: Lead the development and governance of security Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Emergency Response Plans.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Job Description: Electronic Security Systems (ESS) Real Estate Project Manager (12-Month FTC)

Position Title:
ESS Real Estate Project Manager

Reporting To:
BRT Head of Security

Contract Duration:
12 months

Location:
UK Offices

Role Purpose

The ESS Real Estate Project Manager is accountable for the successful execution of multiple, concurrent real estate projects involving the deployment of EY Global Security enterprise access control and CCTV systems (CCURE & Victor). This position is pivotal in ensuring timely project completion, adherence to technical standards and seamless coordination among stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Manage the Request for Proposal (RFP) process for CCURE & Victor electronic security systems, encompassing vendor engagement and selection.
Develop technical design specifications for security system implementations.
Coordinate installation and integration activities with appointed integrator.
Ensure strict compliance with EY minimum baseline standards, Global security policies and all relevant technical requirements.
Participate in project meetings and facilitate effective communication with stakeholders across Global Technology, Real Estate, contractors, and integrators.
Oversee project milestones to guarantee on-time delivery and uphold quality benchmarks.
Provide oversight of the installation of security systems, ensuring all works are executed to the highest standard and in accordance with project specifications. Monitor progress on site, proactively addressing any issues that may arise during installation to minimise disruption and maintain project timelines
Conduct Threat, vulnerability and risk assessments (TVRA) for new property locations and prepare operational requirements documents to inform security system specifications.

Required Skills & Experience

Extensive and proven experience in project management specifically within the electronic security systems sector, with a strong track record of successfully overseeing the delivery and integration of advanced access control and CCTV platforms in real estate environments.
In-depth knowledge of CCURE & Victor systems or comparable enterprise access control and CCTV products.
Understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and Near Field Communication (NFC) technologies.
Experience conducting Threat, Vulnerability and Risk (TVR) assessments.
Extensive understanding of mobile credential technologies.
Proficiency in managing RFP processes and overseeing vendor selection.
Strong stakeholder management and advanced communication capabilities.
Proven ability to coordinate complex initiatives across diverse teams and external partners.
Familiarity with compliance frameworks applicable to enterprise security platforms, such as:
GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) – governing the protection and privacy of personal data
ISO/IEC 27001 – an international standard for information security management systems (ISMS).
SOC 2 (System and Organisation Controls) – focusing on controls relevant to security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of data.

Platform Administration & Operations

Supervise configuration, monitor system health, and manage the lifecycle of iSTAR controllers and IP cameras deployed across the estate.
Perform regular system audits, diagnose technical issues, and implement firmware or software updates as needed to minimise operational disruptions.
Ensure full compliance with GDPR and other relevant data protection regulations, upholding exemplary standards of privacy and regulatory conformity throughout all data handling and system operations.

System Integration & Projects

Lead the integration of CCURE 9000 with Victor/VideoEdge and other third-party security solutions to ensure cohesive interoperability and efficient data flow.
Plan and deliver system upgrades, migrations, and expansion projects, collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, vendors and appointed integrators.
Develop and sustain thorough technical documentation, including system design diagrams, configuration records, and detailed user guides.

Infrastructure

Oversee administration of Windows Server environments and Active Directory to facilitate secure and reliable system operations and user access management.

Collaborate with network infrastructure teams to establish robust connectivity and effective network segmentation for all security platforms.
Work closely with other departments to ensure cybersecurity hardening measures are applied and ensure best practices are followed on every platform, reviewing configurations to reduce vulnerabilities and address emerging threats.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Fraud Intelligence Solution
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC Insurance is deploying modern, AI- and data-driven fraud detection across its insurance business, integrating enterprise RBC fraud capabilities with insurance-specific detection and investigation built in-house on our cloud data platform.

We're hiring a Senior Program Manager, Fraud Intelligence Solution. You'll own the plan, the operating rhythm, and the outcomes: detection running in production, used daily by investigators, governed to regulatory standards, improving quarter over quarter.

This is a technical delivery role. The right candidate has built data and AI capabilities, data platforms, ML scoring pipelines, model deployment, inside a regulated financial institution, and can review code, prototype with AI tools, and challenge architecture and modeling decisions credibly. Fraud is the application domain, not the required expertise. This is not a general program management role: data and AI fluency is a gate, not a nice-to-have.

What will you do?

Lead delivery. Run several delivery teams and a program function. Dated plans, firm checkpoints, quarterly quality targets. Raise alerts and replan when dates slip.
Ship into production. Detection running, investigators using it daily, regulatory requirements met. Build the data foundation for sophisticated detection over time.
Navigate complexity. Drive approvals ahead of the critical path, manage enterprise-partner dependencies, coordinate roadmaps, handle escalations.
Make trade-offs. Arbitrate scope and quality, balancing technical complexity against business value. The program builds on existing platforms, judge when to reuse, when to buy, when building is justified.
Stay technical. Review architecture and scoring designs, read code, prototype with gen AI, challenge modeling and platform decisions.
Partner with the business. Work with claims specialists and investigators, translate their expertise into requirements, prioritize what gets built.
Communicate upward. Represent status, risks, and decisions to senior executives in business terms.

What will you need to succeed?

Must have

Deep working knowledge of cloud data platforms, data engineering pipelines, and ML scoring systems (feature pipelines, supervised models, deployment and monitoring). You can evaluate a scoring architecture and challenge modeling trade-offs. Hands-on SQL/Python within the last 5 years, or equivalent technical depth demonstrable in review.
8+ years in data platform, ML, or AI product delivery (not general program management), including 4+ years leading multi-team delivery (10+ people).
Demonstrated delivery in a regulated financial institution. You've personally navigated architecture governance, model risk management, and security review, and can speak concretely about planning around them.
Experience with mixed-mode delivery: hard-milestone workstreams alongside iterative capability development, in an organization that is not natively agile.
Organizational acumen with strong central functions (data science, architecture, risk). You influence without deferring on substance or escalating every disagreement.
Experience managing dependencies on platform teams or external partners whose roadmap you do not control.

Nice to have

Snowflake, dbt, graph data platforms, or document AI.
OSFI Guideline E-23 or equivalent model risk frameworks (SR 11-7, ECB TRIM).
Standing up or scaling an investigation or operations function alongside a technology build.
Insurance domain knowledge, or fraud/financial crime/investigation experience in any financial services context.

What’s in it for you?

RBC Insurance is an organization that succeeds by bringing out the best in its people. You’ll be part of a supportive, inclusive team that shares common values – including a fundamental respect for each other. At the heart of this is a commitment to diversity. RBC respects and responds to the many competing and evolving priorities in our lives – so you can focus on what you can do best – putting clients first.

A Total Rewards program that includes flexible benefits, work/life balance and career development programs and investment and retirement savings plans
Competitive pay and high-earning potential
All the tools, training, and team support you need to grow your business and career
Flexible work/life balance options
RBCI software tools to boost your productivity and grow your business

Job Skills

API Development, API Development, Architectural Modeling, Backlog Management, Business Case Design, Business Technology Consulting, Change Management, Communication, Customer Service, Customer Success, Data Architecture Development, Data Warehousing (DW), Decision Making, Effectiveness Measurement, Experience Design, Group Problem Solving, Information Technology Consulting, Leadership, Product Development Lifecycle, Product Development Methodology, Product Roadmapping, Product Services, RESTful APIs, Results-Oriented, Teamwork {+ 1 more}

new_jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 28283

Required Travel: 0 - 10%

Employment Type: Full Time/Salaried/Exempt

Anticipated Salary Range: $96,098.00 - $135,000.00

Security Clearance: TS/SCI

Level of Experience: Management HI

This opportunity resides with All-Domain Operations (ADO)
, a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. All-Domain Operations comprises multi-domain operations, platforms and logistics, and intelligence operations.

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.

Leadership at HII – Mission Technologies

HII’s Leadership Capability Framework Outlines The Core Capabilities Expected Of All Leaders Across Mission Technologies. Leaders Are Accountable For Demonstrating Strength In

Know & Grow Your People – Develop talent, empower teams, and build an inclusive environment.
Build Relationships – Strengthen trust, collaboration, and cross-functional partnerships.
Take Ownership – Drive accountability, execution excellence, and results.
Customer First – Anticipate mission needs and deliver value to our partners.
Shape the Future – Inspire innovation and align work with strategic priorities.
Act with Urgency – Make informed decisions and move with purpose.

These capabilities define how leaders inspire teams, deliver results, and shape the future of Mission Technologies.

Job Description

HII Mission Technologies is looking for a Deputy Program Manager near Ft. Gordon, GA.

The Deputy Program Manager is responsible for providing strategic leadership, program oversight, and operational management for U.S. Army or Department of Defense (DoD) programs involving advanced intelligence analysis services. This role ensures successful program execution, resource management, and stakeholder engagement while maintaining compliance with intelligence oversight, security guidelines, and program performance standards. The DPM will guide multidisciplinary teams, support mission objectives, and oversee the development and delivery of high-quality intelligence products and services.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Provide overall program leadership, direction, and management to ensure successful execution of all contractual requirements
Oversee daily operations, personnel performance, and workflow to deliver expert intelligence analysis services
Interface effectively with senior military officials, government stakeholders, and internal leadership to communicate program status, risks, and performance
Manage budgets, timelines, resources, and quality standards to ensure program success
Ensure compliance with intelligence oversight, security protocols, and DoD policies
Support development, implementation, and refinement of program strategies, priorities, and objectives
Lead, mentor, and supervise program staff to sustain high levels of performance and mission support
Coordinate and integrate intelligence capabilities, processes, and tools to meet mission needs
Identify and mitigate risks while implementing process improvements to optimize program outcomes

Minimum Qualifications

4 years relevant progressive experience with Bachelors in related field; 2 years relevant progressive experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 8 years relevant progressive experience.
Expert knowledge of the intelligence cycle and analytical processes that convert collection into intelligence products and database updates
Knowledge of intelligence oversight and security guidelines
Excellent communication skills to interface effectively with senior military leaders, managers, and staff
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
Certification as a Program Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent
Clearance- Must possess and maintain a TS/SCI

Preferred Requirements

Superior understanding of DoD intelligence processes, activities, standards, and analytic tools, with general knowledge of GEOINT operations
Experience planning and executing technical studies and reports for computer systems and networks
Knowledge of and experience with Irregular Warfare concepts and operations

The listed salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, HII's Mission Technologies division takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function and a candidate's education or training, work experience, and key skills.

Meet HII’s Mission Technologies Division

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class. Find the role that’s right for you. Apply today. We look forward to meeting you.

To learn more about Mission Technologies, click here for a short video: https://vimeo.com/732533072

HII is more than a job - it’s an opportunity to build a new future. We offer competitive benefits such as best-in-class medical, dental and vision plan choices; wellness resources; employee assistance programs; Savings Plan Options (401(k)); financial planning tools, life insurance; employee discounts; paid holidays and paid time off; tuition reimbursement; as well as early childhood and post-secondary education scholarships. Why HII

We build the world’s most powerful, survivable naval ships and defense technology solutions that safeguard our seas, sky, land, space and cyber. Our workforce includes skilled tradespeople; artificial intelligence, machine learning (AI/ML) experts; engineers; technologists; scientists; logistics experts; and business administration professionals.

Recognized as one of America’s top large company employers, we are a values and ethics driven organization that puts people’s safety and well-being first. Regardless of your role or where you serve, at HII, you’ll find a supportive and welcoming environment, competitive benefits, and valuable educational and training programs for continual career growth at every stage of your career.

Together we are working to ensure a future where everyone can be free and thrive.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Operations & Safety
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

WSP is looking for a Project Manager to join our industry-leading Operations & Safety team within Intelligent Infrastructure. We provide technical professional services to transport clients throughout the UK and overseas.

A Little More About Your Role…

WSP’s Intelligent Infrastructure discipline works across a wide range of transport and mobility clients (and beyond). While the fundamental goals of the transport system remain unchanged, helping people and goods move efficiently, the drivers influencing the system continue to evolve. Priorities around carbon reduction (net zero), climate resilience, safety and security (zero harm), digitisation, changing customer expectations, and doing more with less (efficiency) are now front and centre.

The Operations & Safety team provides strategy, systems, design, specification and operational monitoring support to a range of internal and external clients, and we require an experienced Project Manager with experience leading projects in this space.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery of project management services and bringing exemplar market leadership and knowledge to lead the delivery of projects on time, to the quality required, and within the allocated budget, including primary client interface.
Manage project budgets and finances, including invoicing, cash collection and forecasting on our Oracle ERP system
Ensure the delivery of client outcomes, whilst meeting utilisation targets, including corrective action and regularly reviewing performance and outputs in conjunction with the Project Director.
Establishes and maintains good working relationships and communication with clients, stakeholders, colleagues, project teams, and internal staff at all levels;
Delivers reports, presentations, project documentation and project management documentation including project status reports, quality management plans and other financial control documents;
Direct the development and deployment of appropriate project control and management methodologies to support both proposals and project delivery;

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Undergraduate Degree, or relevant experience
Awareness of Project Management methodologies and relevant experience at various stages of the project lifecycle, to achieve successful delivery
Relevant Project Management qualification (for example APMQ, PRINCE2 Practitioner or ITIL Foundation)
Experience managing finances, especially on Oracle or similar ERP systems
Ability to lead and mentor other project team members
Able to multi-task and meet various project deadlines

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

new_jobs.description:
Summary

About the Opportunity

The Division of Information Technology Services (ITS) is seeking a highly experienced and motivated individual to join our team as an Senior Infrastructure Project Manager
. This role is responsible for driving the successful delivery of large-scale, complex IT projects and programs that support the university’s strategic priorities. The Senior Project Manager will lead cross-functional teams, manage diverse stakeholder expectations, and ensure that all initiatives are delivered within scope, schedule, and budget—while aligning to business value and user needs. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with a proven track record of managing complex strategic IT initiatives in dynamic environments. This role requires a strategic thinker who is also hands-on, with strong leadership and influencing skills.

This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence in the Boston office 3 days per week
.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. The University is unable to work sponsor for this role, now or in the future

Minimum Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
Project management training/certification preferred (e.g., PMP, Agile, PRINCE2)

Experience

10–15 years of overall IT experience, including 8-10 years of progressive IT project management experience, including managing large, complex, cross-functional IT initiatives in matrixed organizations.
Demonstrated experience in delivering enterprise-level technology projects, such as CRM, ERP, infrastructure, data integration, or cloud-based systems.
Minimum of 7-9 years of experience engaging with business units, technical teams, and executive stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable project plans.
Proven ability to lead diverse project teams, set direction, communicate vision, and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Experienced in navigating organizational change, managing competing priorities, and driving projects forward in ambiguous or evolving environments.
A strong history of using data-driven insights to guide project planning and risk management.

PMO Knowledge And Skills

Expert in project management methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid approaches.
Proficient with project management tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, Confluence and, Jira.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership.
Demonstrated ability to build relationships, foster collaboration, and resolve conflicts across diverse stakeholder groups.
Deep understanding of business processes and IT alignment, with the ability to deliver measurable value.
Skilled in resource planning and budgeting for large-scale projects.
Self-motivated, organized, and capable of working independently in fast-paced environments.
Good understanding of current and emerging technologies and how other enterprises are employing them to drive digital business.
Strong knowledge and understanding of business needs, with the ability to establish and maintain a high level of customer trust and confidence.

Infrastructure Knowledge And Skills

Progressive work experience in Audio Visual (AV) & Network infrastructure; hands-on experience.
Excellent problem solving and decision-making skills.
Familiarity with blueprints, construction documentation, and AutoCad
Knowledge of cabling structures including fiber optic, copper, and coaxial.
Working knowledge of audio-visual (AV) systems, including AV upgrades and installations for classrooms, conference rooms, and event spaces, and their integration with campus IT infrastructure.
Familiarity with low voltage cabling standards and practices, including structured cabling, cable pathways/tray systems, terminations, and testing and certification.
Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including LAN/WAN architecture, switches, routers, wireless access points, and network closet (MDF/IDF) design and buildout.
Broad IT infrastructure knowledge spanning data centers, telecom/network rooms, and campus facilities, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional infrastructure projects that meet industry and university standards.
Higher Education experience.is a plus, though not required:

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Project Leadership & Execution

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple large and complex IT projects across departments, ensuring alignment with university priorities and strategies.
Develop and manage detailed project plans, milestones, scope statements, budgets, timelines, and resource allocations.
Ensure project deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and on budget while maintaining high quality standards.
Conduct risk assessments and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
Monitor project activities, ensuring the currency, quality, and integrity of information, while providing consistency in content.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

Serve as the liaison between technical teams, business units, and executive sponsors.
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
Facilitate effective communication across cross-functional teams to ensure shared understanding of objectives, progress, and changes.
Present project updates, risks, and performance metrics to governance groups and leadership.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

Campfire is a next-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid-market finance teams. We’re building the future of ERP by replacing outdated systems and manual accounting processes with an AI-native platform that helps finance teams move faster and operate more efficiently.

As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll work closely with our Implementation team to help customers successfully deploy Campfire and get up and running quickly. You’ll be hands-on throughout the implementation process, working alongside experienced team members to configure the platform, prepare and migrate data, test workflows, and solve customer challenges.

This is a high-ownership role for someone early in their career who enjoys solving problems, working with customers, and learning how finance systems are implemented in the real world.

The Role

As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll be an important part of the team responsible for getting customers live on Campfire. You’ll partner closely with an Implementation Manager and take ownership of key workstreams across the deployment lifecycle.

You’ll get hands-on experience with system configuration, data migration, testing, accounting workflows, and customer delivery while building the skills to eventually lead implementations independently.

Success in this role means being someone the team can rely on to take ownership of your work, stay organized, solve problems, and keep things moving.

What You'll Do

Partner with Implementation Managers to support customer deployments from kickoff through go-live
Own specific implementation workstreams, keeping tasks, timelines, and deliverables on track
Configure Campfire based on customer accounting workflows, reporting needs, and business requirements
Support data migration from systems such as NetSuite, SAP, QuickBooks, Sage, and Oracle
Help validate data and identify discrepancies during migration and testing
Build and execute test cases across accounting workflows, integrations, and key customer scenarios
Work directly with customers to gather information, answer questions, and help resolve implementation needs
Identify issues and risks early, investigate potential solutions, and escalate when additional support is needed
Partner with Implementation Managers, Product, and Engineering to troubleshoot issues and keep deployments moving
Maintain clear documentation and ensure customer requirements and implementation details are captured accurately
Support go-live activities and post-launch stabilization
Continuously learn Campfire’s product, accounting workflows, and implementation best practices

What We're Looking For

1–4 years of experience in implementation, consulting, accounting systems, ERP, financial systems, or a related field
Experience working with or supporting software implementations, system rollouts, or technical projects
Familiarity with ERP or accounting systems such as NetSuite, SAP, QuickBooks, Sage, or Oracle
Comfort working with financial data and understanding how accounting systems and workflows fit together
Strong attention to detail, especially when working with data, configurations, and testing
A proactive problem-solver who takes ownership and follows issues through to resolution
Strong project and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities
Comfortable working directly with customers and communicating clearly with different stakeholders
Curious and eager to learn, with the ability to ramp quickly in a fast-moving environment
CPA, accounting, finance, or related background is a plus

What You'll Learn

How modern finance teams operate and how their accounting systems are structured
How to implement and configure an ERP from the ground up
Data migration, testing, integrations, and go-live processes
How to work directly with customers to understand requirements and solve complex problems
How to manage implementation workstreams and eventually lead deployments independently

· ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଭାଷାରେ ପାଠନ ଓ ଲେଖନରେ ପରଙ୍ଗମତା ଏବଂ ଇଂରାଜୀ ଭାଷାରେ ମୌଳିକ ପାରଙ୍ଗମତା
· ଜଣେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଯିଏ ଗତ 5 ବର୍ଷ ଧରି ଭାରତରେ ରହୁଛନ୍ତି ଏବଂ ଭାରତୀୟ ବ୍ୟବସାୟ, ଗଣମାଧ୍ୟମ, କ୍ରୀଡା, ସମାଚାର, ସାମାଜିକ ଗଣମାଧ୍ୟମ ଏବଂ ସାଂସ୍କୃତିକ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ବିଷୟରେ ଜ୍ଞାନୀ।
· ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶନାମାନଙ୍କୁ ଅନୁସରଣ କରିବା ଓ ସର୍ଚ ଇଞ୍ଜିନ, ମାନଚିତ୍ର, ୱେବସାଇଟ ଆଧାରିତ ସୂଚନା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ଅନଲାଇନ୍ ଗବେଷଣା କରିବା
· ମାନଚିତ୍ର, ସମ୍ବାଦ, ଧ୍ୱନି ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ କାମ, ରିଲେଭାନ୍ସ ଭଳି ଭିନ୍ନ-ଭିନ୍ନ ଧରଣର କାମ ସହ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବାର କ୍ଷମତା
· ଦୈନିକ broadband ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ସଂଯୋଗ, କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ଓ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ସଫ୍ଟୱେର ର ପହଞ୍ଚ

new_jobs.title: Information Security Analyst
new_jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring Information Security Analysts to join our team, blending traditional security analysis with AI-driven workflows to protect Hudl's global operations. In this role, you’ll design agentic workflows, tune detection engines and lead active response efforts to handle security threats directed against Hudl.

As An Information Security Analyst, You’ll

Orchestrate AI and build prompts. You'll develop high-performing prompts and design multi-step agentic workflows that ingest, enrich and correlate security data. You’ll continuously tune agent behaviors to keep outputs accurate, consistent and practical.
Investigate and respond to threats. You’ll maintain prompt libraries for playbooks, generate clear incident summaries and guide containment efforts. As a core member of our 24/7/365 on-call and incident response team, you’ll own security issues through resolution.
Automate detections and prioritize vulnerabilities. You'll optimize phishing engines, refine EDR logic to reduce noise and use agentic workflows to analyze and prioritize vulnerability exposures.
Track metrics and partner across teams. You’ll track key performance indicators and risk metrics for senior leadership while partnering with Security Engineering to plug visibility gaps.

Location

Time spent collaborating with other Hudlies in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently prioritizing applicants within commuting distance of Lincoln or Omaha, Nebraska. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

Experienced. You have 2–3 years of relevant information security experience, including exposure to modern programming languages and DevOps building blocks.
Versed in security frameworks. You have a strong understanding of OWASP and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks.
A strong communicator. You can distill complex incidents into clear, actionable documentation and present findings confidently to leadership.
A team player. You handle multiple projects with ease, jump in during incidents, and care about keeping Hudlies and our products safe.
Organized multitasker. You can prioritize your workload and manage multiple security projects at the same time.

Nice-to-Haves

Certified. You hold one or more security or privacy certifications (such as SC2, SANS or AWS).
Tech and cloud savvy. You have familiarity with modern programming languages, DevOps building blocks and hands-on experience with AWS AgentCore, Security Logging or Lambda.
Tooling experience. You have experience working with CSPM and vulnerability management tools.

Our Role

Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
Support your mental and physical health. We care about our employees’ wellbeing. Our Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups and fitness partner Peerfit have you covered.
Cover your medical insurance. We have multiple plans to pick from to ensure you’ll have the coverage you (and your dependents) want, including vision, dental, fertility healthcare and family forming benefits.
Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that’s free money. We’ll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below— starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$76,000 - $127,000 USD

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary And Responsibilities

As our Program Manager of Infection Prevention ,
you will help our facility’s patients, personnel, and visitors maintain a safe environment by coordinating all infection prevention and surveillance activities so they can benefit from a healthcare setting protected from the transmission of diseases and infections.

Every day you will assess, develop, and operationalize programs, policies, and procedures to address the infection prevention needs of the facility. You will be expected to conduct regular surveillance rounds, lead root cause analyses for healthcare-associated infections, ensure compliance with federal, state, and CMS regulations, and provide expert consultation and education to clinical staff and hospital committees.

To be successful in this role you must possess strong analytical and communication skills, maintain current knowledge of infection prevention professional society guidelines, and hold a valid Certification in Infection Control (CIC). You must also demonstrate the ability to effectively manage multiple projects, work collaboratively with hospital administration and diverse staff, and provide data-driven recommendations to support quality patient care.

Responsible for the oversight of daily operations of the infection Prevention Department in regards to the facility compliance with Hospital Accreditation Standards, State and CMS regulations.
Ongoing assessment and development of programs, policies and procedures, and forms to address the infection prevention needs of employees, volunteers, contract workers, independent contractors, physicians, registry workers and students in accordance with the guidelines established by the regulatory agencies.
Works in collaboration with Hospital Administration to develop and manage an Infection Prevention Program that incorporates essential facility strategic plan elements that align with the goals, objectives, and risk assessments of the Infection Prevention Program.
Develops and operationalizes the Infection Prevention Program’s annual risk assessment, annual plans, and annual evaluations. Identifies and implements updates to the Infection Prevention Program when new regulations and /or professional guidelines are published.
Ensures all functions of the Infection Prevention Program are conducted including surveillance, rounds to inpatient and outpatient units including perioperative, procedural and ancillary departments, and mandatory reporting to local and state health departments, NHSN, CMS, etc.
Maintains current knowledge of infection prevention professional society guidelines, best practices and regulatory requirements as demonstrated by attending infection prevention conferences and workshops, reviewing current infection prevention literature, guidelines and national standard and networking with Health System and external Infection Prevention Specialists.

Job Requirements

Required

Bachelor's degree in a healthcare related field and five (5) years of experience OR Associates Degree in a healthcare related field and seven (7) years of experience
Three (3) years of experience as an Infection Preventionist in an acute care facility
Certified in Infection Control (CIC) within 24 months of hire

Where You'll Work

Founded in 1967, Dignity Health - Mercy San Juan Medical Center is a 377-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital located in Carmichael, California. Serving over 100,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including a Level II Trauma Center, Level III NICU, heart care, cancer care, women’s health, and neurology. Additionally, Mercy San Juan Medical Center has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. It is a Comprehensive Stroke Center, the highest level of stroke care certification awarded by The Joint Commission.

One Community. One Mission. One California
